  3990                              <1> ;---WAITF-----------------------------------------------------------------------
  3991                              <1> ;	FIXED TIME WAIT ROUTINE (HARDWARE CONTROLLED - NOT PROCESSOR)
  3992                              <1> ; ENTRY:
  3993                              <1> ;	(CX) =	COUNT OF 15.085737 MICROSECOND INTERVALS TO WAIT
  3994                              <1> ;	      	MEMORY REFRESH TIMER 1 OUTPUT USED AS REFERENCE
  3995                              <1> ; EXIT:
  3996                              <1> ;	       	AFTER (CX) TIME COUNT (PLUS OR MINUS 16 MICROSECONDS)
  3997                              <1> ;	(CX) = 0
  3998                              <1> ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3999                              <1> 
  4000                              <1> ; Refresh period: 30 micro seconds (15-80 us)
  4001                              <1> ; (16/12/2014 - AWARDBIOS 1999 - ATORGS.ASM, WAIT_REFRESH)
  4002                              <1> 
  4003                              <1> ;WAITF:					; DELAY FOR (CX)*15.085737 US
  4004                              <1> 	;push	AX			; SAVE WORK REGISTER (AH)
  4005                              <1> 	; 11/04/2021
  4006 0000248A 50                  <1> 	push	eax
  4007                              <1> 	; 16/12/2014
  4008                              <1> 	;shr	cx, 1			; convert to count of 30 micro seconds
  4009 0000248B D1E9                <1> 	shr	ecx, 1	; 21/02/2015
  4010                              <1> ;17/12/2014	
  4011                              <1> ;WAITF1:
  4012                              <1> ;	in	al, PORT_B   ;061h	; READ CURRENT COUNTER OUTPUT STATUS
  4013                              <1> ;	and	al, REFRESH_BIT	;00010000b ; MASK FOR REFRESH DETERMINE BIT
  4014                              <1> ;	cmp	al, ah			; DID IT JUST CHANGE
  4015                              <1> ;	je	short WAITF1		; WAIT FOR A CHANGE IN OUTPUT LINE
  4016                              <1> ;	mov	ah, al			; SAVE NEW FLAG STATE
  4017                              <1> ;	loop	WAITF1			; DECREMENT HALF CYCLES TILL COUNT END
  4018                              <1> 	;
  4019                              <1> 	; 17/12/2014
  4020                              <1> 	;
  4021                              <1> 	; Modification from 'WAIT_REFRESH' procedure of AWARD BIOS - 1999
  4022                              <1> 	;
  4023                              <1> ;WAIT_REFRESH:  Uses port 61, bit 4 to have CPU speed independent waiting.
  4024                              <1> ;   	INPUT:  CX = number of refresh periods to wait
  4025                              <1> ;     	       (refresh periods = 1 per 30 microseconds on most machines)
  4026                              <1> WR_STATE_0:
  4027 0000248D E461                <1> 	in	al, PORT_B		; IN AL,SYS1
  4028 0000248F A810                <1> 	test	al, 010h
  4029 00002491 74FA                <1> 	JZ	short WR_STATE_0
  4030                              <1> WR_STATE_1:
  4031 00002493 E461                <1> 	in	al, PORT_B		; IN AL,SYS1
  4032 00002495 A810                <1> 	test	al, 010h
  4033 00002497 75FA                <1> 	jnz	short WR_STATE_1
  4034 00002499 E2F2                <1>         loop    WR_STATE_0
  4035                              <1> 	;
  4036                              <1> 	;pop	ax			; RESTORE (AH)
  4037                              <1> 	; 11/04/2021
  4038 0000249B 58                  <1> 	pop	eax
  4039 0000249C C3                  <1> 	retn				; (CX) = 0

  4048                              <1> ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  4049                              <1> ; WRITE_STRING								       :
  4050                              <1> ;	THIS ROUTINE WRITES A STRING OF CHARACTERS TO THE CRT.		       :
  4051                              <1> ; INPUT 								       :
  4052                              <1> ;	(AL) = WRITE STRING COMMAND  0 - 3				       :
  4053                              <1> ;	(BH) = DISPLAY PAGE (ACTIVE PAGE)				       :
  4054                              <1> ;	(CX) = COUNT OF CHARACTERS TO WRITE, IF (CX) = 0 THEN RETURN	       :
  4055                              <1> ;	(DX) = CURSOR POSITION FOR START OF STRING WRITE		       :
  4056                              <1> ;	(BL) = ATTRIBUTE OF CHARACTER TO WRITE IF (AL) = 0  OR	(AL) = 1       :
  4057                              <1> ;	(EBP) = SOURCE STRING OFFSET					       :
  4058                              <1> ; OUTPUT								       :
  4059                              <1> ;	NONE								       :
  4060                              <1> ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  4061                              <1> 
  4062                              <1> ; AL = 00h: Assign all characters the attribute in BL; do not update cursor
  4063                              <1> ; AL = 01h: Assign all characters the attribute in BL; update cursor
  4064                              <1> ; AL = 02h: Use attributes in string; do not update cursor
  4065                              <1> ; AL = 03h: Use attributes in string; update cursor
  4066                              <1> 
  4067                              <1> WRITE_STRING:

  4077                              <1> 	;jnb	VIDEO_RETURN		; IF OPTION INVALID THEN RETURN

  4228                              <1> 	; 04/08/2022 - TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5
  4229                              <1> 	; 12/09/2016 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)

  4231                              <1> 	; derived from 'Plex86/Bochs VGABios' source code
  4232                              <1> 	; vgabios-0.7a (2011)
  4233                              <1> 	; by the LGPL VGABios developers Team (2001-2008)
  4234                              <1> 	; 'vgabios.c', ' biosfn_write_string'
  4235                              <1> 
  4236                              <1> 	; INPUT 								  :
  4237                              <1> 	;	(AL) = WRITE STRING COMMAND  0 - 3				  :
  4238                              <1> 	;	(BH) = DISPLAY PAGE (ACTIVE PAGE)				  :
  4239                              <1> 	;	(CX) = COUNT OF CHARACTERS TO WRITE, IF (CX) = 0 THEN RETURN	  :
  4240                              <1> 	;	(DX) = CURSOR POSITION FOR START OF STRING WRITE		  :
  4241                              <1> 	;	(BL) = ATTRIBUTE OF CHARACTER TO WRITE IF (AL) = 0  OR	(AL) = 1  :
  4242                              <1> 	;	(EBP) = SOURCE STRING OFFSET					  :
  4243                              <1> 	; OUTPUT								  :
  4244                              <1> 	;	NONE								  :
  4245                              <1> 	;-------------------------------------------------------------------------;
  4246                              <1> 
  4247                              <1> 	; AL = 00h: Assign all characters the attribute in BL; do not update cursor
  4248                              <1> 	; AL = 01h: Assign all characters the attribute in BL; update cursor
  4249                              <1> 	; AL = 02h: Use attributes in string; do not update cursor
  4250                              <1> 	; AL = 03h: Use attributes in string; update cursor
  4251                              <1> 	
  4252                              <1> 	; biosfn_write_string(GET_AL(),GET_BH(),GET_BL(),CX,GET_DH(),GET_DL(),ES,BP);
  4253                              <1> 	; static void biosfn_write_string (flag,page,attr,count,row,col,seg,offset)
  4254                              <1> 
  4255                              <1> 	; // Read curs info for the page
  4256                              <1>  	; biosfn_get_cursor_pos(page,&dummy,&oldcurs);
  4257                              <1> 	; bh = video page = 0

  4259                              <1> 	
  4260                              <1> 	; // if row=0xff special case : use current cursor position
  4261                              <1> 	; if(row==0xff)
  4262                              <1> 	;  {col=oldcurs&0x00ff;
  4263                              <1> 	;   row=(oldcurs&0xff00)>>8;
  4264                              <1> 	;  }

  4277                              <1>

  4329                              <1> ; 07/07/2016
  4330                              <1> ; 27/06/2016 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  4331                              <1> ; VIDEO1.ASM - 24/03/1985 (IBM PC-AT BIOS source code)
  4332                              <1> ;------------------------------------------------------
  4333                              <1> ;  SCROLL UP
  4334                              <1> ;   THIS ROUTINE SCROLLS UP THE INFORMATION ON THE CRT
  4335                              <1> ; ENTRY ---
  4336                              <1> ;  CH,CL = UPPER LEFT CORNER OF REGION TO SCROLL
  4337                              <1> ;  DH,DL = LOWER RIGHT CORNER OF REGION TO SCROLL
  4338                              <1> ;   BOTH OF THE ABOVE ARE IN CHARACTER POSITIONS
  4339                              <1> ;  BH = FILL VALUE FOR BLANKED LINES
  4340                              <1> ;  AL = # LINES TO SCROLL (AL=0 MEANS BLANK THE ENTIRE FIELD)
  4341                              <1> ;  DS = DATA SEGMENT
  4342                              <1> ;  ES = REGEN SEGMENT
  4343                              <1> ; EXIT --
  4344                              <1> ;  NOTHING, THE SCREEN IS SCROLLED
  4345                              <1> ;--------------------------------------------------------
  4346                              <1> 
  4347                              <1> 	; cl = upper left column
  4348                              <1> 	; ch = upper left row
  4349                              <1> 	; dl = lower rigth column
  4350                              <1> 	; dh = lower right row
  4351                              <1> 	;
  4352                              <1> 	; al = line count (AL=0 means blank entire fields)
  4353                              <1> 	; bl = fill value for blanked lines
  4354                              <1> 	; bh = unused
  4355                              <1> 
  4356                              <1> GRAPHICS_UP:
  4357                              <1> 	; 07/07/2016
  4358                              <1> 	; AH = Current video mode, [CRT_MODE]
  4359 000025CB 80FC07              <1> 	cmp	ah, 7
  4360 000025CE 7762                <1> 	ja	short vga_graphics_up
  4361                              <1> 	;je	n0
  4362                              <1> 
  4363 000025D0 88C7                <1> 	mov	bh, al			; save line count in BH
  4364                              <1> 	;mov	ax, cx			; GET UPPER LEFT POSITION INTO AX REG
  4365                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  4366 000025D2 89C8                <1> 	mov	eax, ecx
  4367                              <1> 
  4368                              <1> ;-----	USE CHARACTER SUBROUTINE FOR POSITIONING
  4369                              <1> ;-----	ADDRESS RETURNED IS MULTIPLIED BY 2 FROM CORRECT VALUE
  4370                              <1> 
  4371 000025D4 E8BA050000          <1> 	call	GRAPH_POSN
  4372                              <1> 	;movzx	edi, ax			; SAVE RESULT AS DESTINATION ADDRESS
  4373                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  4374 000025D9 89C7                <1> 	mov	edi, eax
  4375                              <1> 
  4376                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE SIZE OF WINDOW
  4377                              <1> 
  4378 000025DB 6629CA              <1> 	sub	dx, cx
  4379 000025DE 6681C20101          <1>         add     dx, 101h                ; ADJUST VALUES
  4380 000025E3 C0E602              <1> 	sal	dh, 2			; MULTIPLY ROWS BY 4 AT 8 VERT DOTS/CHAR
  4381                              <1> 					; AND EVEN/ODD ROWS
  4382                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE CRT MODE
  4383                              <1> 
  4384 000025E6 803D[90680000]06    <1> 	cmp	byte [CRT_MODE], 6	; TEST FOR MEDIUM RES
  4385 000025ED 7304                <1>         jnc	short _R7_              ; FIND_SOURCE
  4386                              <1> 
  4387                              <1> ;-----	MEDIUM RES UP
  4388 000025EF D0E2                <1> 	sal	dl, 1			; # COLUMNS * 2, SINCE 2 BYTES/CHAR
  4389                              <1> 	;sal	di, 1			; OFFSET *2 SINCE 2 BYTES/CHAR
  4390                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  4391 000025F1 D1E7                <1> 	sal	edi, 1
  4392                              <1> 
  4393                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE THE SOURCE ADDRESS IN THE BUFFER
  4394                              <1> _R7_:                                   ; FIND_SOURCE
  4395 000025F3 81C700800B00        <1> 	add	edi, 0B8000h
  4396 000025F9 C0E702              <1> 	sal	bh, 2			; multiply number of lines by 4
  4397 000025FC 7430                <1>         jz	short _R11              ; IF ZERO, THEN BLANK ENTIRE FIELD
  4398 000025FE B050                <1> 	mov	al, 80			; 80 BYTES/ROW
  4399 00002600 F6E7                <1> 	mul	bh			; determine offset to source
  4400                              <1> 	;movzx	esi, ax			; offset to source
  4401                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  4402 00002602 89C6                <1> 	mov	esi, eax
  4403 00002604 01FE                <1> 	add	esi, edi		; SET UP SOURCE
  4404 00002606 88F4                <1> 	mov	ah, dh			; NUMBER OF ROWS IN FIELD
  4405 00002608 28FC                <1> 	sub	ah, bh			; determine number to move
  4406                              <1> 
  4407                              <1> ;-----	LOOP THROUGH, MOVING ONE ROW AT A TIME, BOTH EVEN AND ODD FIELDS
  4408                              <1> _R8:                                    ; ROW_LOOP
  4409 0000260A E8FD030000          <1>         call    _R17                    ; MOVE ONE ROW
  4410 0000260F 6681EEB01F          <1> 	sub	si, 2000h-80		; MOVE TO NEXT ROW
  4411 00002614 6681EFB01F          <1> 	sub	di, 2000h-80
  4412 00002619 FECC                <1> 	dec	ah			; NUMBER OF ROWS TO MOVE
  4413 0000261B 75ED                <1>         jnz     short _R8               ; CONTINUE TILL ALL MOVED
  4414                              <1> 
  4415                              <1> ;-----	FILL IN THE VACATED LINE(S)
  4416                              <1> _R9:                                    ; CLEAR ENTRY
  4417 0000261D 88D8                <1> 	mov	al, bl			; attribute to fill with
  4418                              <1> _R10_:
  4419 0000261F E804040000          <1>         call    _R18                    ; CLEAR THAT ROW
  4420 00002624 6681EFB01F          <1> 	sub	di, 2000h-80		; POINT TO NEXT LINE
  4421 00002629 FECF                <1> 	dec	bh			; number of lines to fill
  4422 0000262B 75F2                <1> 	jnz	short _R10_             ; CLEAR LOOP
  4423 0000262D C3                  <1> 	retn				; EVERYYHING DONE
  4424                              <1> 
  4425                              <1> _R11:                                   ; BLANK_FIELD
  4426 0000262E 88F7                <1> 	mov	bh, dh			; set blank count to everything in field
  4427 00002630 EBEB                <1>         jmp     short _R9               ; CLEAR THE FIELD
  4428                              <1> 
  4429                              <1> vga_graphics_up:
  4430                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022 - TRDOS 386 Kertnel v2.0.5
  4431                              <1> 	; 12/04/2021

  4982                              <1> ; 03/08/2022 - TRDOS 386 Kernel V2.0.5

  4984                              <1> ; 27/06/2016 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  4985                              <1> ; VIDEO1.ASM - 24/03/1985 (IBM PC-AT BIOS source code)
  4986                              <1> ;------------------------------------------------------
  4987                              <1> ; SCROLL DOWN
  4988                              <1> ;  THIS ROUTINE SCROLLS DOWN THE INFORMATION ON THE CRT
  4989                              <1> ; ENTRY --
  4990                              <1> ;  CH,CL = UPPER LEFT CORNER OF REGION TO SCROLL
  4991                              <1> ;  DH,DL = LOWER RIGHT CORNER OF REGION TO SCROLL
  4992                              <1> ;   BOTH OF THE ABOVE ARE IN CHARACTER POSITIONS
  4993                              <1> ;  BH = FILL VALUE FOR BLANKED LINES
  4994                              <1> ;  AL = # LINES TO SCROLL (AL=0 MEANS BLANK THE ENTIRE FIELD)
  4995                              <1> ;  DS = DATA SEGMENT
  4996                              <1> ;  ES = REGEN SEGMENT
  4997                              <1> ; EXIT --
  4998                              <1> ;  NOTHING, THE SCREEN IS SCROLLED
  4999                              <1> ;--------------------------------------------------------
  5000                              <1> 
  5001                              <1> 	; cl = upper left column
  5002                              <1> 	; ch = upper left row
  5003                              <1> 	; dl = lower rigth column
  5004                              <1> 	; dh = lower right row
  5005                              <1> 	;
  5006                              <1> 	; al = line count (AL=0 means blank entire fields)
  5007                              <1> 	; bl = fill value for blanked lines
  5008                              <1> 	; bh = unused
  5009                              <1> 
  5010                              <1> GRAPHICS_DOWN:
  5011                              <1> 	; 07/07/2016
  5012                              <1> 	; ah = Current video mode, [CRT_MODE]
  5013                              <1> 	; std				; SET DIRECTION
  5014 0000289D 80FC07              <1> 	cmp	ah, 7
  5015 000028A0 7769                <1>         ja	short vga_graphics_down ; 03/08/2022
  5016                              <1> 	;je	_n0
  5017                              <1> 
  5018 000028A2 88C7                <1> 	mov	bh, al			; save line count in BH
  5019                              <1> 	;mov	ax, dx			; GET LOWER RIGHT POSITION INTO AX REG
  5020                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  5021 000028A4 89D0                <1> 	mov	eax, edx
  5022                              <1> 
  5023                              <1> ;-----	USE CHARACTER SUBROUTINE FOR POSITIONING
  5024                              <1> ;-----	ADDRESS RETURNED IS MULTIPLIED BY 2 FROM CORRECT VALUE
  5025                              <1> 
  5026 000028A6 E8E8020000          <1> 	call	GRAPH_POSN
  5027                              <1> 	;movzx	edi, ax			; SAVE RESULT AS DESTINATION ADDRESS
  5028                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  5029 000028AB 89C7                <1> 	mov	edi, eax
  5030                              <1> 
  5031                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE SIZE OF WINDOW
  5032                              <1> 
  5033 000028AD 6629CA              <1> 	sub	dx, cx
  5034 000028B0 6681C20101          <1>         add     dx, 101h                ; ADJUST VALUES
  5035 000028B5 C0E602              <1> 	sal	dh, 2			; MULTIPLY ROWS BY 4 AT 8 VERT DOTS/CHAR
  5036                              <1> 					; AND EVEN/ODD ROWS
  5037                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE CRT MODE
  5038                              <1> 
  5039 000028B8 803D[90680000]06    <1> 	cmp	byte [CRT_MODE], 6	; TEST FOR MEDIUM RES
  5040 000028BF 7305                <1> 	jnc	short _R12              ; FIND_SOURCE_DOWN
  5041                              <1> 
  5042                              <1> ;-----	MEDIUM RES DOWN
  5043 000028C1 D0E2                <1> 	sal	dl, 1			; # COLUMNS * 2, SINCE 2 BYTES/CHAR
  5044                              <1> 	;sal	di, 1			; OFFSET *2 SINCE 2 BYTES/CHAR
  5045                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  5046 000028C3 D1E7                <1> 	sal	edi, 1
  5047                              <1> 	;inc	di			; POINT TO LAST BYTE
  5048                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  5049 000028C5 47                  <1> 	inc	edi
  5050                              <1> 
  5051                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE THE SOURCE ADDRESS IN THE BUFFER
  5052                              <1> 
  5053                              <1> _R12:                                   ; FIND_SOURCE_DOWN
  5054 000028C6 81C700800B00        <1> 	add	edi, 0B8000h		
  5055 000028CC 6681C7F000          <1> 	add	di, 240			; POINT TO LAST ROW OF PIXELS
  5056 000028D1 C0E702              <1> 	sal	bh, 2			; multiply number of lines by 4
  5057 000028D4 74(06)              <1> 	jz	short 6			; IF ZERO, THEN BLANK ENTIRE FIELD
  5058 000028D6 B050                <1> 	mov	al, 80			; 80 BYTES/ROW
  5059 000028D8 F6E7                <1> 	mul	bh			; determine offset to source
  5060 000028DA 89FE                <1> 	mov	esi, edi		; SET UP SOURCE
  5061                              <1> 	;sub	si, ax			; SUBTRACT THE OFFSET
  5062                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  5063 000028DC 29C6                <1> 	sub	esi, eax
  5064 000028DE 88F4                <1> 	mov	ah, dh			; NUMBER OF ROWS IN FIELD
  5065 000028E0 28FC                <1> 	sub	ah, bh			; determine number to move
  5066                              <1> 
  5067                              <1> ;-----	LOOP THROUGH, MOVING ONE ROW AT A TIME, BOTH EVEN AND ODD FIELDS
  5068                              <1> 
  5069                              <1> _R13:                                   ; ROW_LOOP_DOWN
  5070 000028E2 E825010000          <1>         call    _R17                    ; MOVE ONE ROW
  5071 000028E7 6681EE5020          <1> 	sub	si, 2000h+80		; MOVE TO NEXT ROW
  5072 000028EC 6681EF5020          <1> 	sub	di, 2000h+80
  5073 000028F1 FECC                <1> 	dec	ah			; NUMBER OF ROWS TO MOVE
  5074 000028F3 75ED                <1> 	jnz	short _R13              ; CONTINUE TILL ALL MOVED
  5075                              <1> 
  5076                              <1> ;-----	FILL IN THE VACATED LINE(S)
  5077                              <1> _R14:                                   ; CLEAR_ENTRY_DOWN
  5078 000028F5 88D8                <1> 	mov	al, bl			; attribute to fill with
  5079                              <1> _R15_:                                  ; CLEAR_LOOP_DOWN
  5080 000028F7 E82C010000          <1> 	call	_R18			; CLEAR A ROW
  5081 000028FC 6681EF5020          <1> 	sub	di, 2000h+80		; POINT TO NEXT LINE
  5082 00002901 FECF                <1> 	dec	bh			; number of lines to fill
  5083 00002903 75F2                <1>         jnz	short _R15_             ; CLEAR_LOOP_DOWN
  5084                              <1> 	; 18/11/2020
  5085 00002905 FC                  <1> 	cld				; RESET THE DIRECTION FLAG
  5086                              <1> 	
  5087 00002906 C3                  <1> 	retn				; EVERYTHING DONE
  5088                              <1> 
  5089                              <1> _R16:                                   ; BLANK_FIELD_DOWN
  5090 00002907 88F7                <1> 	mov	bh, dh			; set blank count to everything in field
  5091 00002909 EBEA                <1>         jmp     short _R14              ; CLEAR THE FIELD
  5092                              <1> 
  5093                              <1> vga_graphics_down:
  5094                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022 - TRDOS 386 Kertnel v2.0.5
  5095                              <1> 	; 12/04/2021
  5096                              <1> 	; 08/08/2016
  5097                              <1> 	; 07/08/2016
  5098                              <1> 	; 31/07/2016
  5099                              <1> 	; 07/07/2016 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  5100                              <1> 	;
  5101                              <1> 	; derived from 'Plex86/Bochs VGABios' source code
  5102                              <1> 	; vgabios-0.7a (2011)
  5103                              <1> 	; by the LGPL VGABios developers Team (2001-2008)
  5104                              <1> 	; 'vgabios.c', 'biosfn_scroll'
  5105                              <1> 	;
  5106                              <1> 
  5107                              <1> 	; cl = upper left column
  5108                              <1> 	; ch = upper left row
  5109                              <1> 	; dl = lower rigth column
  5110                              <1> 	; dh = lower right row
  5111                              <1> 	;
  5112                              <1> 	; al = line count (AL=0 means blank entire fields)
  5113                              <1> 	; bl = fill value for blanked lines
  5114                              <1> 	; bh = unused
  5115                              <1> 	;
  5116                              <1> 	; ah = [CRT_MODE], current video mode
  5117                              <1> 
  5118 0000290B FC                  <1>         cld     ; !!! Clear direction flag !!!
  5119                              <1> 
  5120 0000290C 88C7                <1> 	mov	bh, al ; 31/07/2016
  5121                              <1> 
  5122 0000290E BE[AC680000]        <1> 	mov	esi, vga_modes
  5123 00002913 89F7                <1> 	mov	edi, esi
  5124 00002915 83C710              <1> 	add	edi, vga_mode_count
  5125                              <1> vga_g_down_0:
  5126 00002918 AC                  <1> 	lodsb
  5127 00002919 38E0                <1> 	cmp	al, ah ; [CRT_MODE]
  5128 0000291B 7405                <1> 	je	short vga_g_down_1
  5129 0000291D 39FE                <1> 	cmp	esi, edi
  5130 0000291F 72F7                <1> 	jb	short vga_g_down_0
  5131                              <1> 	; xor 	bh, bh	; 31/07/2016
  5132 00002921 C3                  <1> 	retn	; nothing to do
  5133                              <1> vga_g_down_1:
  5134 00002922 88F8                <1> 	mov	al, bh ; 31/07/2016
  5135 00002924 83C64F              <1> 	add	esi, vga_memmodel - (vga_modes + 1)
  5136                              <1> 	; [ESI] = VGA memory model number (LINEAR8, PLANAR4, PLANAR1)
  5137                              <1>

  5298                              <1> ;-----	ROUTINE TO MOVE ONE ROW OF INFORMATION
  5299                              <1> 
  5300                              <1> _R17:
  5301 00002A0C 0FB6CA              <1> 	movzx	ecx, dl			; NUMBER OF BYTES IN THE ROW
  5302 00002A0F 56                  <1> 	push	esi
  5303 00002A10 57                  <1> 	push	edi			; SAVE POINTERS
  5304 00002A11 F3A4                <1> 	rep	movsb			; MOVE THE EVEN FIELD
  5305 00002A13 5F                  <1> 	pop	edi
  5306 00002A14 5E                  <1> 	pop	esi
  5307 00002A15 6681C60020          <1> 	add	si, 2000h
  5308 00002A1A 6681C70020          <1> 	add	di, 2000h		; POINT TO THE ODD FIELD
  5309 00002A1F 56                  <1> 	push	esi
  5310 00002A20 57                  <1> 	push	edi			; SAVE THE POINTERS
  5311 00002A21 88D1                <1> 	mov	cl, dl			; COUNT BACK
  5312 00002A23 F3A4                <1> 	rep	movsb			; MOVE THE ODD FIELD
  5313 00002A25 5F                  <1> 	pop	edi
  5314 00002A26 5E                  <1> 	pop	esi			; POINTERS BACK
  5315 00002A27 C3                  <1> 	retn				; RETURN TO CALLER
  5316                              <1> 
  5317                              <1> ;-----	CLEAR A SINGLE ROW
  5318                              <1> 
  5319                              <1> _R18:

  5321 00002A2B 57                  <1> 	push	edi			; SAVE POINTER
  5322 00002A2C F3AA                <1> 	rep	stosb			; STORE THE NEW VALUE
  5323 00002A2E 5F                  <1> 	pop	edi			; POINTER BACK
  5324 00002A2F 6681C70020          <1> 	add	di, 2000h		; POINT TO ODD FIELD
  5325 00002A34 57                  <1> 	push	edi
  5326 00002A35 88D1                <1> 	mov	cl, dl
  5327 00002A37 F3AA                <1> 	rep	stosb			; FILL THE ODD FIELD
  5328 00002A39 5F                  <1> 	pop	edi
  5329 00002A3A C3                  <1> 	retn				; RETURN TO CALLER

  5331                              <1> ; 03/08/2022 - TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5
  5332                              <1> ; 04/07/2016
  5333                              <1> ; 01/07/2016
  5334                              <1> ; 30/06/2016 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  5335                              <1> ; VIDEO1.ASM - 24/03/1985 (IBM PC-AT BIOS source code)
  5336                              <1> ;--------------------------------------------------
  5337                              <1> ; GRAPHICS WRITE
  5338                              <1> ;  THIS ROUTINE WRITES THE ASCII CHARACTER TO THE CURRENT
  5339                              <1> ;  POSITION ON THE SCREEN.
  5340                              <1> ; ENTRY --
  5341                              <1> ;  AL = CHARACTER TO WRITE
  5342                              <1> ;  BL = COLOR ATTRIBUTE TO BE USED FOR FOREGROUND COLOR
  5343                              <1> ;	IF BIT 7 IS SET, THE CHAR IS XOR'D INTO THE REGEN BUFFER
  5344                              <1> ;	(0 IS USED FOR THE BACKGROUND COLOR)
  5345                              <1> ;  CX = NUMBER OF CHARS TO WRITE
  5346                              <1> ;  DS = DATA SEGMENT
  5347                              <1> ;  ES = REGEN SEGMENT
  5348                              <1> ; EXIT --
  5349                              <1> ;  NOTHING IS RETURNED
  5350                              <1> ;
  5351                              <1> ; GRAPHICS READ
  5352                              <1> ;  THIS ROUTINE READS THE ASCII CHARACTER AT THE CURRENT CURSOR
  5353                              <1> ;  POSITION ON THE SCREEN BY MATCHING THE DOTS ON THE SCREEN TO THE
  5354                              <1> ;  CHARACTER GENERATOR CODE POINTS
  5355                              <1> ; ENTRY --
  5356                              <1> ;  NONE (0 IS ASSUMED AS THE BACKGROUND COLOR)
  5357                              <1> ; EXIT --
  5358                              <1> ;  AL = CHARACTER READ AT THAT POSITION (0 RETURNED IF NONE FOUND)
  5359                              <1> ;
  5360                              <1> ; FOR BOTH ROUTINES, THE IMAGES USED TO FORM CHARS ARE CONTAINED IN ROM
  5361                              <1> ;  FOR THE 1ST 128 CHARS.  TO ACCESS CHARS IN THE SECOND HALF, THE USER
  5362                              <1> ;  MUST INITIALIZE THE VECTOR AT INTERRUPT 1FH (LOCATION 0007CH) TO
  5363                              <1> ;  POINT TO THE USER SUPPLIED TABLE OF GRAPHIC IMAGES (8X8 BOXES).
  5364                              <1> ;  FAILURE TO DO SO WILL CAUSE IN STRANGE RESULTS
  5365                              <1> ;-----------------------------------------------------
  5366                              <1> 
  5367                              <1> GRAPHICS_WRITE:
  5368 00002A3B 25FF000000          <1> 	and 	eax, 0FFh		; ZERO TO HIGH OF CODE POINT
  5369 00002A40 50                  <1> 	push	eax			; SAVE CODE POINT VALUE
  5370                              <1> 
  5371                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE POSITION IN REGEN BUFFER TO PUT CODE POINTS
  5372                              <1> 
  5373 00002A41 E846010000          <1> 	call	S26			; FIND LOCATION IN REGEN BUFFER
  5374 00002A46 89C7                <1> 	mov	edi, eax		; REGEN POINTER IN DI
  5375                              <1> 
  5376                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE REGION TO GET CODE POINTS FROM
  5377                              <1> 
  5378 00002A48 58                  <1> 	pop	eax			; RECOVER CODE POINT
  5379                              <1> 
  5380 00002A49 BE[48680100]        <1> 	mov	esi, CRT_CHAR_GEN	; OFFSET OF IMAGES
  5381                              <1> 
  5382                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE GRAPHICS MODE IN OPERATION
  5383                              <1> 					; DETERMINE_MODE
  5384                              <1> 	;sal	ax, 3			; MULTIPLY CODE POINT VALUE BY 8
  5385                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  5386 00002A4E C1E003              <1> 	sal	eax, 3
  5387 00002A51 01C6                <1> 	add	esi, eax		; SI HAS OFFSET OF DESIRED CODES
  5388                              <1> 	
  5389 00002A53 803D[90680000]06    <1> 	cmp	byte [CRT_MODE], 6
  5390 00002A5A 7231                <1> 	jc	short S6		; TEST FOR MEDIUM RESOLUTION MODE
  5391                              <1> 
  5392                              <1> ;-----	HIGH RESOLUTION MODE
  5393                              <1> 
  5394 00002A5C 81C700800B00        <1> 	add	edi, 0B8000h
  5395                              <1> S1:					; HIGH_CHAR
  5396 00002A62 57                  <1> 	push	edi			; SAVE REGEN POINTER
  5397 00002A63 56                  <1> 	push	esi			; SAVE CODE POINTER
  5398 00002A64 B604                <1> 	mov	dh, 4			; NUMBER OF TIMES THROUGH LOOP
  5399                              <1> S2:
  5400 00002A66 AC                  <1> 	lodsb				; GET BYTE FROM CODE POINTS
  5401 00002A67 F6C380              <1> 	test	bl, 80h			; SHOULD WE USE THE FUNCTION
  5402 00002A6A 7515                <1> 	jnz	short S5		; TO PUT CHAR IN
  5403 00002A6C AA                  <1> 	stosb				; STORE IN REGEN BUFFER
  5404 00002A6D AC                  <1> 	lodsb
  5405                              <1> S4:
  5406 00002A6E 8887FF1F0000        <1> 	mov	[edi+2000h-1], al	; STORE IN SECOND HALF
  5407 00002A74 83C74F              <1> 	add	edi, 79			; MOVE TO NEXT ROW IN REGEN
  5408 00002A77 FECE                <1> 	dec	dh			; DONE WITH LOOP
  5409 00002A79 75EB                <1> 	jnz	short S2
  5410 00002A7B 5E                  <1> 	pop	esi
  5411 00002A7C 5F                  <1> 	pop	edi			; RECOVER REGEN POINTER
  5412 00002A7D 47                  <1> 	inc	edi			; POINT TO NEXT CHAR POSITION
  5413 00002A7E E2E2                <1> 	loop	S1			; MORE CHARS TO WRITE
  5414 00002A80 C3                  <1> 	retn
  5415                              <1> 
  5416                              <1> S5:
  5417 00002A81 3207                <1> 	xor	al, [edi]		; EXCLUSIVE OR WITH CURRENT
  5418 00002A83 AA                  <1> 	stosb				; STORE THE CODE POINT
  5419 00002A84 AC                  <1> 	lodsb				; AGAIN FOR ODD FIELD
  5420 00002A85 3287FF1F0000        <1> 	xor	al, [edi+2000h-1]
  5421 00002A8B EBE1                <1> 	jmp	short S4		; BACK TO MAINSTREAM
  5422                              <1> 
  5423                              <1> ;-----	MEDIUM RESOLUTION WRITE
  5424                              <1> S6:					; MED_RES_WRITE
  5425 00002A8D 88DA                <1> 	mov	dl, bl			; SAVE HIGH COLOR BIT
  5426                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  5427 00002A8F D1E7                <1> 	sal	edi, 1
  5428                              <1> 	;sal	di, 1			; OFFSET*2 SINCE 2 BYTES/CHAR
  5429                              <1> 					; EXPAND BL TO FULL WORD OF COLOR
  5430 00002A91 80E303              <1> 	and	bl, 3			; ISOLATE THE COLOR BITS ( LOW 2 BITS )
  5431 00002A94 B055                <1> 	mov	al, 055h		; GET BIT CONVERSION MULTIPLIER
  5432 00002A96 F6E3                <1> 	mul	bl			; EXPAND 2 COLOR BITS TO 4 REPLICATIONS
  5433 00002A98 88C3                <1> 	mov	bl, al			; PLACE BACK IN WORK REGISTER
  5434 00002A9A 88C7                <1> 	mov	bh, al			; EXPAND TO 8 REPLICATIONS OF COLOR BITS
  5435 00002A9C 81C700800B00        <1> 	add	edi, 0B8000h
  5436                              <1> S7:                                     ; MED_CHAR
  5437 00002AA2 57                  <1> 	push	edi			; SAVE REGEN POINTER
  5438 00002AA3 56                  <1> 	push	esi			; SAVE THE CODE POINTER
  5439 00002AA4 B604                <1> 	mov	dh, 4			; NUMBER OF LOOPS
  5440                              <1> S8:
  5441 00002AA6 AC                  <1> 	lodsb				; GET CODE POINT
  5442 00002AA7 E8B1000000          <1> 	call	S21			; DOUBLE UP ALL THE BITS
  5443 00002AAC 6621D8              <1> 	and	ax, bx			; CONVERT TO FOREGROUND COLOR ( 0 BACK )
  5444 00002AAF 86E0                <1> 	xchg	ah, al			; SWAP HIGH/LOW BYTES FOR WORD MOVE
  5445 00002AB1 F6C280              <1> 	test	dl, 80h			; IS THIS XOR FUNCTION
  5446 00002AB4 7403                <1> 	jz	short S9		; NO, STORE IT IN AS IS
  5447 00002AB6 663307              <1> 	xor	ax, [edi]		; DO FUNCTION WITH LOW/HIGH
  5448                              <1> S9:
  5449 00002AB9 668907              <1> 	mov	[edi], ax		; STORE FIRST BYTE HIGH, SECOND LOW
  5450 00002ABC AC                  <1> 	lodsb				; GET CODE POINT
  5451 00002ABD E89B000000          <1> 	call	S21
  5452 00002AC2 6621D8              <1> 	and	ax, bx			; CONVERT TO COLOR
  5453 00002AC5 86E0                <1> 	xchg	ah, al			; SWAP HIGH/LOW BYTES FOR WORD MOVE
  5454 00002AC7 F6C280              <1> 	test	dl, 80h			; AGAIN, IS THIS XOR FUNCTION
  5455 00002ACA 7407                <1> 	jz	short _S10		; NO, JUST STORE THE VALUES
  5456 00002ACC 66338700200000      <1> 	xor	ax, [edi+2000h]		; FUNCTION WITH FIRST HALF LOW
  5457                              <1> _S10:
  5458 00002AD3 66898700200000      <1> 	mov	[edi+2000h], ax		; STORE SECOND PORTION HIGH
  5459 00002ADA 6683C750            <1> 	add	di, 80			; POINT TO NEXT LOCATION
  5460 00002ADE FECE                <1> 	dec	dh
  5461 00002AE0 75C4                <1> 	jnz	short S8		; KEEP GOING
  5462 00002AE2 5E                  <1> 	pop	esi			; RECOVER CODE POINTER
  5463 00002AE3 5F                  <1> 	pop	edi			; RECOVER REGEN POINTER
  5464 00002AE4 47                  <1> 	inc	edi			; POINT TO NEXT CHAR POSITION
  5465 00002AE5 47                  <1> 	inc	edi
  5466 00002AE6 E2BA                <1> 	loop	S7			; MORE TO WRITE
  5467 00002AE8 C3                  <1> 	retn
  5468                              <1>

  5597                              <1> ;  COMPARE AGAINST THE CURRENT FOREGROUND COLOR, AND PLACE

  5667                              <1> ; SET_COLOR
  5668                              <1> ;	THIS ROUTINE WILL ESTABLISH THE BACKGROUND COLOR, THE OVERSCAN COLOR,
  5669                              <1> ;	AND THE FOREGROUND COLOR SET FOR MEDIUM RESOLUTION GRAPHICS
  5670                              <1> ; INPUT
  5671                              <1> ;	(BH) HAS COLOR ID
  5672                              <1> ;		IF BH=0, THE BACKGROUND COLOR VALUE IS SET
  5673                              <1> ;			FROM THE LOW BITS OF BL (0-31)
  5674                              <1> ;		IF BH=1, THE PALETTE SELECTION IS MADE
  5675                              <1> ;			BASED ON THE LOW BIT OF BL:
  5676                              <1> ;				0 = GREEN, RED, YELLOW FOR COLORS 1,2,3
  5677                              <1> ;				1 = BLUE, CYAN, MAGENTA FOR COLORS 1,2,3
  5678                              <1> ;	(BL) HAS THE COLOR VALUE TO BE USED
  5679                              <1> ; OUTPUT
  5680                              <1> ;	THE COLOR SELECTION IS UPDATED
  5681                              <1> ;----------------------------------------------
  5682                              <1> SET_COLOR:
  5683 00002BA5 803D[90680000]07    <1>         cmp     byte [CRT_MODE], 7      ; 09/07/2016

  5694 00002BBC 08FF                <1> 	or	bh, bh			; IS THIS COLOR 0?
  5695 00002BBE 7512                <1> 	jnz	short M20		; OUTPUT COLOR 1
  5696                              <1> 
  5697                              <1> ;-----	HANDLE COLOR 0 BY SETTING THE BACKGROUND COLOR
  5698                              <1> 
  5699 00002BC0 24E0                <1> 	and	al, 0E0h 		; TURN OFF LOW 5 BITS OF CURRENT
  5700 00002BC2 80E31F              <1> 	and	bl, 01Fh 		; TURN OFF HIGH 3 BITS OF INPUT VALUE

  5702                              <1> M19:					; OUTPUT THE PALETTE

  5705 00002BCD E9FEEFFFFF          <1> 	jmp	VIDEO_RETURN

  5723                              <1> ;  DOT AT THE INDICATED LOCATION
  5724                              <1> ; ENTRY --
  5725                              <1> ;   DX = ROW (0-199)	(THE ACTUAL VALUE DEPENDS ON THE MODE)
  5726                              <1> ;   CX = COLUMN ( 0-639) ( THE VALUES ARE NOT RANGE CHECKED )

  5729                              <1> ;	BIT 7 OF AL = 1 INDICATES XOR THE VALUE INTO THE LOCATION

  5731                              <1> ;   ES = REGEN SEGMENT

  5758 00002BFF D2E0                <1> 	shl	al, cl			; LEFT JUSTIFY THE VALUE

  5800 00002C34 F6C380              <1> 	test	bl, 80h			; IS IT ON
  5801 00002C37 750D                <1> 	jnz	short R2		; YES, XOR THE DOT
  5802 00002C39 F6D4                <1> 	not	ah			; SET MASK TO REMOVE THE INDICATED BITS
  5803 00002C3B 20E1                <1> 	and	cl, ah
  5804 00002C3D 08C8                <1> 	or	al, cl			; OR IN THE NEW VALUE OF THOSE BITS
  5805                              <1> R1:					; FINISH_DOT
  5806 00002C3F 8806                <1> 	mov	[esi], al		; RESTORE THE BYTE IN MEMORY
  5807                              <1> 	;;pop	AX
  5808 00002C41 E98AEFFFFF          <1> 	jmp	VIDEO_RETURN		; RETURN FROM VIDEO I/O
  5809                              <1> R2:					; XOR_DOT
  5810 00002C46 30C8                <1> 	xor	al, cl			; EXCLUSIVE OR THE DOTS
  5811 00002C48 EBF5                <1> 	jmp	short R1		; FINISH UP THE WRITING
  5812                              <1> 
  5813                              <1> ; 02/08/2022 - TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5
  5814                              <1> ; 01/07/2016 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  5815                              <1> ; VIDEO1.ASM - 24/03/1985 (IBM PC-AT BIOS source code)
  5816                              <1> 
  5817                              <1> ;----------------------------------------------
  5818                              <1> ; THIS SUBROUTINE DETERMINES THE REGEN BYTE LOCATION OF THE
  5819                              <1> ; INDICATED ROW COLUMN VALUE IN GRAPHICS MODE.
  5820                              <1> ; ENTRY --
  5821                              <1> ;  DX = ROW VALUE (0-199)
  5822                              <1> ;  CX = COLUMN VALUE (0-639)
  5823                              <1> ; EXIT --
  5824                              <1> ;  SI = OFFSET INTO REGEN BUFFER FOR BYTE OF INTEREST
  5825                              <1> ;  AH = MASK TO STRIP OFF THE BITS OF INTEREST
  5826                              <1> ;  CL = BITS TO SHIFT TO RIGHT JUSTIFY THE MASK IN AH
  5827                              <1> ;  DH = # BITS IN RESULT
  5828                              <1> ;  BX = MODIFIED
  5829                              <1> ;-----------------------------------------------
  5830                              <1> R3:
  5831                              <1> 
  5832                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE 1ST BYTE IN INDICATED ROW BY MULTIPLYING ROW VALUE BY 40
  5833                              <1> ;-----	 ( LOW BIT OF ROW DETERMINES EVEN/ODD, 80 BYTES/ROW )
  5834                              <1> 
  5835 00002C4A 0FB7F0              <1> 	movzx	esi, ax			; WILL SAVE AL AND AH DURING OPERATION
  5836 00002C4D B028                <1> 	mov	al, 40
  5837 00002C4F F6E2                <1> 	mul	dl			; AX= ADDRESS OF START OF INDICATED ROW
  5838 00002C51 A808                <1> 	test	al, 08H 		; TEST FOR EVEN/ODD ROW CALCULATED
  5839 00002C53 7404                <1> 	JZ	short R4		; JUMP IF EVEN ROW
  5840 00002C55 6605D81F            <1> 	add	ax, 2000h-40		; OFFSET TO LOCATION OF ODD ROWS ADJUST
  5841                              <1> R4:					; EVEN_ROW
  5842                              <1> 	;xchg	si, ax			; MOVE POINTER TO (SI) AND RECOVER (AX)
  5843                              <1> 	; 02/08/2022
  5844 00002C59 96                  <1> 	xchg	esi, eax
  5845 00002C5A 81C600800B00        <1> 	add	esi, 0B8000h
  5846                              <1> 	;mov	dx, cx			; COLUMN VALUE TO DX
  5847 00002C60 0FB7D1              <1> 	movzx	edx, cx
  5848                              <1> 
  5849                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE GRAPHICS MODE CURRENTLY IN EFFECT
  5850                              <1> 
  5851                              <1> ; SET UP THE REGISTERS ACCORDING TO THE MODE
  5852                              <1> ; CH = MASK FOR LOW OF COLUMN ADDRESS ( 7/3 FOR HIGH/MED RES )
  5853                              <1> ; CL = # OF ADDRESS BITS IN COLUMN VALUE ( 3/2 FOR H/M )
  5854                              <1> ; BL = MASK TO SELECT BITS FROM POINTED BYTE ( 80H/C0H FOR H/M )
  5855                              <1> ; BH = NUMBER OF VALID BITS IN POINTED BYTE ( 1/2 FOR H/M )
  5856                              <1> 
  5857 00002C63 66BBC002            <1> 	mov	bx, 2C0h
  5858 00002C67 66B90203            <1> 	mov	cx, 302h 		; SET PARMS FOR MED RES
  5859 00002C6B 803D[90680000]06    <1> 	cmp	byte [CRT_MODE], 6
  5860 00002C72 7208                <1> 	jc	short R5		; HANDLE IF MED RES
  5861 00002C74 66BB8001            <1> 	mov	bx, 180h
  5862 00002C78 66B90307            <1> 	mov	cx, 703h 		; SET PARMS FOR HIGH RES
  5863                              <1> 
  5864                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE BIT OFFSET IN BYTE FROM COLUMN MASK
  5865                              <1> R5:
  5866 00002C7C 20D5                <1> 	and	ch, dl			; ADDRESS OF PEL WITHIN BYTE TO CH
  5867                              <1> 
  5868                              <1> ;-----	DETERMINE BYTE OFFSET FOR THIS LOCATION IN COLUMN
  5869                              <1> 
  5870                              <1> 	;shr	dx, cl			; SHIFT BY CORRECT AMOUNT
  5871                              <1> 	;add	si, dx			; INCREMENT THE POINTER
  5872                              <1> 	; 02/08/2022
  5873 00002C7E D3EA                <1> 	shr	edx, cl
  5874 00002C80 01D6                <1> 	add	esi, edx
  5875 00002C82 88FE                <1> 	mov	dh, bh			; GET THE # OF BITS IN RESULT TO DH
  5876                              <1> 
  5877                              <1> ;-----	MULTIPLY BH (VALID BITS IN BYTE) BY CH (BIT OFFSET)
  5878                              <1> 
  5879 00002C84 28C9                <1> 	sub	cl, cl			; ZERO INTO STORAGE LOCATION
  5880                              <1> R6:
  5881 00002C86 D0C8                <1> 	ror	al, 1			; LEFT JUSTIFY VALUE IN AL (FOR WRITE)
  5882 00002C88 00E9                <1> 	add	cl, ch			; ADD IN THE BIT OFFSET VALUE
  5883 00002C8A FECF                <1> 	dec	bh			; LOOP CONTROL
  5884 00002C8C 75F8                <1> 	jnz	short R6		; ON EXIT, CL HAS COUNT TO RESTORE BITS
  5885 00002C8E 88DC                <1> 	mov	ah, bl			;  GET MASK TO AH
  5886 00002C90 D2EC                <1> 	shr	ah, cl			;  MOVE THE MASK TO CORRECT LOCATION
  5887 00002C92 C3                  <1> 	retn				;  RETURN WITH EVERYTHING SET UP
  5888                              <1> 
  5889                              <1> load_dac_palette:
  5890                              <1> 	; 02/08/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)

  5924 00002CA8 7719                <1> 	ja	short l_dac_p_3

  5926 00002CAC 7507                <1> 	jnz	short l_dac_p_1

  5932 00002CBA EB0E                <1> 	jmp	short l_dac_p_4
  5933                              <1> l_dac_p_2:

  5951 00002CD8 C3                  <1> 	retn

  5961 00002CE1 EE                  <1> 	out	dx, al

  5967                              <1> gray_scale_summing:
  5968                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.5)
  5969                              <1> 	; 12/04/2021
  5970                              <1> 	; 03/07/2016 (TRDOS 386 = TRDOS v2.0)
  5971                              <1> 	; (set_mode_vga)
  5972                              <1> 	; derived from 'Plex86/Bochs VGABios' source code
  5973                              <1> 	; vgabios-0.7a (2011)
  5974                              <1> 	; by the LGPL VGABios developers Team (2001-2008)
  5975                              <1> 	; 'vgabios.c', 'biosfn_perform_gray_scale_summing'
  5976                              <1> 	;
  5977                              <1> 	; Oracle VirtualBox 5.0.24 VGABios Source Code
  5978                              <1> 	; ('vgabios.c', 'vgatables.h', 'vgafonts.h', 'vgarom.asm')
  5979                              <1> 	;
  5980                              <1> 
  5981                              <1> 	; INPUT -> EBX = Start address (color index <= 255)
  5982                              <1> 	;	   ECX = Count (<= 256)
  5983                              <1> 	; OUTPUT -> (E)CX = 0
  5984                              <1> 	; (Modifed registers: EAX, ECX, EDX, EBX)
  5985                              <1> 
  5986 00002CE5 66BADA03            <1> 	mov	dx, 3DAh ; VGAREG_ACTL_RESET
  5987 00002CE9 EC                  <1> 	in	al, dx
  5988 00002CEA 30C0                <1> 	xor	al, al ; 0
  5989                              <1> 	;mov	dx, 3C0h ; VGAREG_ACTL_ADDRESS
  5990                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  5991 00002CEC B2C0                <1> 	mov	dl, 0C0h
  5992 00002CEE EE                  <1> 	out	dx, al	; clear bit 5
  5993                              <1> 			; (while loading palette registers)
  5994                              <1> 	; set read address and switch to read mode
  5995                              <1> g_s_s_1:

  5999 00002CF1 88D8                <1> 	mov	al, bl
  6000 00002CF3 EE                  <1> 	out	dx, al
  6001                              <1> 	; get 6-bit wide RGB data values
  6002                              <1>  	; intensity = (0.3*Red)+(0.59*Green)+(0.11*Blue)
  6003                              <1> 	; i = ( ( 77*r + 151*g + 28*b ) + 0x80 ) >> 8;
  6004                              <1> 	;mov	dx, 3C9h ; VGAREG_DAC_DATA
  6005                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  6006 00002CF4 B2C9                <1> 	mov	dl, 0C9h
  6007 00002CF6 EC                  <1> 	in	al, dx ; red
  6008 00002CF7 B44D                <1> 	mov	ah, 77 ; 0.3* Red
  6009 00002CF9 F6E4                <1> 	mul	ah
  6010                              <1> 	;push	ax
  6011                              <1> 	; 12/04/2021
  6012 00002CFB 50                  <1> 	push	eax
  6013 00002CFC EC                  <1> 	in	al, dx ; green
  6014 00002CFD B497                <1> 	mov	ah, 151  ; 0.59 * Green
  6015 00002CFF F6E4                <1> 	mul	ah
  6016                              <1> 	;push	ax
  6017                              <1> 	; 12/04/2021
  6018 00002D01 50                  <1> 	push	eax
  6019 00002D02 EC                  <1> 	in	al, dx ; blue
  6020 00002D03 B41C                <1> 	mov	ah, 28 ; 0.11 * Blue
  6021 00002D05 F6E4                <1> 	mul	ah
  6022                              <1> 	;pop	dx
  6023                              <1> 	; 12/04/2021
  6024 00002D07 5A                  <1> 	pop	edx
  6025 00002D08 6601D0              <1> 	add	ax, dx
  6026                              <1> 	;pop	dx
  6027                              <1> 	; 12/04/2021
  6028 00002D0B 5A                  <1> 	pop	edx
  6029 00002D0C 6601D0              <1> 	add	ax, dx
  6030 00002D0F 66058000            <1> 	add	ax, 80h
  6031 00002D13 B03F                <1> 	mov	al, 3Fh
  6032 00002D15 38C4                <1> 	cmp	ah, al	; if(i>0x3f)i=0x3f
  6033 00002D17 7602                <1> 	jna	short g_s_s_2
  6034 00002D19 88C4                <1> 	mov	ah, al
  6035                              <1> g_s_s_2:
  6036                              <1> 	;mov	dx, 3C8h  ; VGAREG_DAC_WRITE_ADDRESS
  6037                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  6038 00002D1B B2C8                <1> 	mov	dl, 0C8h
  6039 00002D1D 88D8                <1> 	mov	al, bl ; color index
  6040 00002D1F EE                  <1> 	out	dx, al
  6041 00002D20 88E0                <1> 	mov	al, ah ; intensity

  6046 00002D25 88E0                <1> 	mov	al, ah ; intensity
  6047 00002D27 EE                  <1> 	out	dx, al ; G (R=G=B)

  6061 00002D35 B020                <1> 	mov	al, 20h

  6063                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022

  6069                              <1> vga_write_char_attr:
  6070                              <1> vga_write_char_only:
  6071                              <1> 	; 08/07/2016 (TRDOS 386 = TRDOS v2.0)
  6072                              <1> 	;
  6073                              <1> 	; derived from 'Plex86/Bochs VGABios' source code

  7985                              <1> get_font_info:
  7986                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.5)
  7987                              <1> 	; 08/01/2021 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.3)
  7988                              <1> 	; 19/09/2016
  7989                              <1> 	; 08/08/2016
  7990                              <1> 	; 10/07/2016
  7991                              <1> 	; Get Current Character Generator Info (VGA)
  7992                              <1> 	;
  7993                              <1> 	; derived from 'Plex86/Bochs VGABios' source code
  7994                              <1> 	; vgabios-0.7a (2011)
  7995                              <1> 	; by the LGPL VGABios developers Team (2001-2008)
  7996                              <1> 	; 'vgabios.c', 'biosfn_get_font_info'
  7997                              <1> 
  7998                              <1> 	; Modified for TRDOS 386 !
  7999                              <1> 	;
  8000                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  8001                              <1> 	;    AX = 1130h
  8002                              <1> 	;    BL = 0 -> Get info for current VGA font
  8003                              <1> 	;	       (BH = unused)
  8004                              <1> 	;    19/09/2016
  8005                              <1> 	;    BL > 0 -> Get requested character font data
  8006                              <1> 	;	 BL = 1 -> vgafont8
  8007                              <1> 	;        BL = 2 -> vgafont14
  8008                              <1> 	;	 BL = 3 -> vgafont16
  8009                              <1> 	;	;08/01/2021
  8010                              <1> 	;	 BL = 4 -> user defined 8x8 font
  8011                              <1> 	;	 BL = 5 -> user defined 8x14 font
  8012                              <1> 	;	 BL = 6 -> user defined 8x16 font
  8013                              <1> 	;	 BL > 6 -> Invalid function (for now!)
  8014                              <1> 	;	 BH = ASCII code of the first character
  8015                              <1> 	;	 ECX = Number of characters from the 1st char
  8016                              <1> 	;	 ECX >= 256 -> All (256-BH) characters
  8017                              <1> 	;	 ECX = 0 -> All characters (BH = unused)
  8018                              <1> 	;        EDX = User's Buffer Address
  8019                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
  8020                              <1> 	;    AL = height (scanlines), bytes per character
  8021                              <1> 	;    AH = screen rows
  8022                              <1> 	;    Byte 16-23 of EAX = number of columns
  8023                              <1> 	;    Byte 24-31 of EAX = 
  8024                              <1> 	;	  0 -> default font (not configured yet)
  8025                              <1> 	;	  0FFh -> user defined font
  8026                              <1> 	;	  14 = vgafont14
  8027                              <1> 	;	   8 = vgafont8
  8028                              <1> 	;	  16 = vgafont16
  8029                              <1> 	;   If BL input > 0 -> 
  8030                              <1> 	;       EAX = Actual transfer count
  8031                              <1> 	;
  8032 000035A6 20DB                <1> 	and	bl, bl
  8033 000035A8 740F                <1> 	jz	short gfi_1
  8034                              <1> 	; invalid function (input)
  8035                              <1> 	; 08/01/2021
  8036 000035AA 80FB04              <1> 	cmp	bl, 4
  8037 000035AD 7263                <1> 	jb	short gfi_5
  8038 000035AF 7441                <1> 	je	short gfi_3
  8039 000035B1 80FB06              <1> 	cmp	bl, 6
  8040 000035B4 744C                <1> 	je	short gfi_4
  8041                              <1> 	; bh = 5 or bh > 6
  8042                              <1> gfi_0:
  8043 000035B6 31C0                <1> 	xor	eax, eax ; 0
  8044 000035B8 C3                  <1> 	retn
  8045                              <1> gfi_1:
  8046 000035B9 A0[94680000]        <1> 	mov	al, [CHAR_HEIGHT]
  8047 000035BE 8A25[98680000]      <1> 	mov	ah, [VGA_ROWS]
  8048 000035C4 C1E010              <1> 	shl	eax, 16
  8049 000035C7 A0[92680000]        <1> 	mov	al, [CRT_COLS]
  8050 000035CC 8B0D[FAA20100]      <1> 	mov	ecx, [VGA_INT43H]
  8051 000035D2 21C9                <1> 	and	ecx, ecx
  8052 000035D4 7418                <1> 	jz	short gfi_2 ; 0 = default font
  8053                              <1> 	; 08/01/2021
  8054 000035D6 FECC                <1> 	dec	ah ; 0FFh
  8055 000035D8 81F900400900        <1> 	cmp	ecx, VGAFONT16USER
  8056 000035DE 740E                <1> 	je	short gfi_2
  8057 000035E0 81F900500900        <1> 	cmp	ecx, VGAFONT8USER
  8058 000035E6 7406                <1> 	je	short gfi_2	
  8059 000035E8 8A25[94680000]      <1> 	mov	ah, [CHAR_HEIGHT] ; font size = height
  8060                              <1> gfi_2:
  8061 000035EE C1C010              <1> 	rol	eax, 16
  8062 000035F1 C3                  <1> 	retn
  8063                              <1> gfi_3:
  8064                              <1> 	; 08/01/2021
  8065 000035F2 F605[32BE0100]08    <1> 	test	byte [ufont], 08h ; 8x8 user font
  8066 000035F9 74BB                <1> 	jz	short gfi_0 ; not loaded !

  8068                              <1> 	;mov	bl, 8

  8074 00003609 74AB                <1> 	jz	short gfi_0 ; not loaded !
  8075 0000360B BE00400900          <1> 	mov	esi, VGAFONT16USER ; *
  8076 00003610 EB15                <1> 	jmp	short gfi_7
  8077                              <1> gfi_5:
  8078 00003612 80FB02              <1> 	cmp	bl, 2
  8079 00003615 7230                <1> 	jb	short gfi_9
  8080 00003617 7709                <1> 	ja	short gfi_6

  8083 0000361E B30E                <1> 	mov	bl, 14
  8084 00003620 EB07                <1> 	jmp	short gfi_8 
  8085                              <1> gfi_6:
  8086                              <1> 	; BL = 3 -> vgafont16
  8087 00003622 BE[487E0100]        <1> 	mov	esi, vgafont16 ; *
  8088                              <1> gfi_7:
  8089 00003627 B310                <1> 	mov	bl, 16
  8090                              <1> gfi_8:
  8091 00003629 89D7                <1> 	mov	edi, edx ; **
  8092 0000362B 09C9                <1> 	or	ecx, ecx
  8093 0000362D 7421                <1> 	jz	short gfi_11 ; all chars from the 00h
  8094                              <1> 	;mov	al, bh ; character index
  8095                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  8096 0000362F 0FB6C7              <1> 	movzx	eax, bh
  8097 00003632 F6E3                <1> 	mul	bl ; char index * char height/size
  8098                              <1> 	;movzx	edx, ax
  8099                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  8100                              <1> 	;add	esi, edx ; *
  8101 00003634 01C6                <1> 	add	esi, eax
  8102 00003636 31D2                <1> 	xor	edx, edx
  8103 00003638 FECA                <1> 	dec	dl 
  8104                              <1> 	; edx = 0FFh = 255
  8105                              <1> 	;mov	dx, 255
  8106 0000363A 28FA                <1> 	sub	dl, bh
  8107                              <1> 	;inc	dx
  8108                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  8109 0000363C 42                  <1> 	inc	edx
  8110 0000363D 39D1                <1> 	cmp	ecx, edx
  8111 0000363F 770F                <1> 	ja	short gfi_11
  8112 00003641 7411                <1> 	je	short gfi_12

  8114 00003645 EB0D                <1> 	jmp	short gfi_12
  8115                              <1> gfi_9:

  8117 00003647 BE[48680100]        <1> 	mov	esi, vgafont8 ; *
  8118                              <1> gfi_10:

  8120 0000364E EBD9                <1> 	jmp	short gfi_8
  8121                              <1> gfi_11:
  8122                              <1> 	;mov	ecx, 256
  8123                              <1> 	; 03/08/2022
  8124 00003650 29C9                <1> 	sub	ecx, ecx
  8125 00003652 FEC5                <1> 	inc	ch
  8126                              <1> 	; ecx = 100h 
  8127                              <1> gfi_12:
  8128                              <1> 	; 08/01/2021
  8129 00003654 89C8                <1> 	mov	eax, ecx ; character count
  8130 00003656 30FF                <1> 	xor	bh, bh
  8131 00003658 66F7E3              <1> 	mul	bx ; char count * char height/size
  8132 0000365B 89C1                <1>  	mov	ecx, eax
  8133                              <1> 
  8134                              <1> 	; ESI = source address in system space
  8135                              <1> 	; EDI = user's buffer address

  8695                              <1> 	; 10/08/2016
  8696                              <1> 	; DAC Color Paging Functions

  8991                              <1> ; * (TRDOS 386, INT 31h, VESA Video Bios functions)
  8992                              <1> ; * ---------------------------------------------------------
  8993                              <1> ; * Function 01h - Return VBE Mode Information
  8994                              <1> ; * ---------------------------------------------------------
  8995                              <1> ; * Input:
  8996                              <1> ; *		AX = 4F01h
  8997                              <1> ; *		CX = Mode number
  8998                              <1> ; *    (ES:DI) EDI = Pointer to ModeInfoBlock structure
  8999                              <1> ; * Output:
  9000                              <1> ; *		AX = VBE Return Status
  9001                              <1> ; *

  9184 00003A21 8A461B              <1> 	mov	al, [esi+MODEINFO.BitsPerPixel]
  9185 00003A24 88470E              <1> 	mov	[edi+LFBINFO.bpp], al
  9186 00003A27 29C0                <1> 	sub	eax, eax
  9187 00003A29 668B4614            <1> 	mov	ax, [esi+MODEINFO.XResolution]

  9189 00003A31 89C2                <1> 	mov	edx, eax ; 19/12/2020

  9191 00003A37 6689470C            <1> 	mov	[edi+LFBINFO.Y_res], ax

  9195                              <1> 	; edx = 0

 11472                              <1> pci_get_lfb_addr:
 11473                              <1> 	; 11/12/2020
 11474                              <1> 	; Get linear frame buffer base from PCI
 11475                              <1> 	; (vgabios.c, 02/01/2020, vruppert)
 11476                              <1> 	;
 11477                              <1> 	; Input:
 11478                              <1> 	;	ax = PCI device vendor id
 11479                              <1> 	; Output:
 11480                              <1> 	;	ax  = LFB address (high 16 bit) (zf=0)
 11481                              <1> 	;	eax = 0 -> not found (error) (zf=1)
 11482                              <1> 	;
 11483                              <1> 	; Modified registers: eax
 11484                              <1> 
 11485 000040FE 53                  <1> 	push	ebx
 11486 000040FF 51                  <1> 	push	ecx
 11487 00004100 52                  <1> 	push	edx
 11488                              <1> 	;
 11489 00004101 89C3                <1> 	mov	ebx, eax
 11490 00004103 31C9                <1> 	xor	ecx, ecx
 11491 00004105 28D2                <1> 	sub	dl, dl	; mov dl, 0
 11492 00004107 E842000000          <1> 	call	pci_read_reg
 11493 0000410C 6683F8FF            <1> 	cmp	ax, 0FFFFh
 11494 00004110 7417                <1> 	je	short pci_get_lfb_addr_fail
 11495                              <1> pci_get_lfb_addr_next_dev:
 11496 00004112 28D2                <1> 	sub	dl, dl ; mov dl, 0
 11497 00004114 E835000000          <1> 	call	pci_read_reg
 11498 00004119 6639D8              <1> 	cmp	ax, bx	; check vendor
 11499 0000411C 740F                <1> 	je	short pci_get_lfb_addr_found
 11500 0000411E 6683C108            <1> 	add	cx, 08h
 11501 00004122 6681F90002          <1> 	cmp	cx, 200h ; search bus 0 and 1
 11502 00004127 72E9                <1> 	jb	short pci_get_lfb_addr_next_dev
 11503                              <1> pci_get_lfb_addr_fail:
 11504 00004129 31C0                <1> 	xor	eax, eax ; no LFB
 11505                              <1> 	; zf = 1
 11506 0000412B EB1D                <1> 	jmp	short pci_get_lfb_addr_return
 11507                              <1> pci_get_lfb_addr_found:
 11508 0000412D B210                <1> 	mov	dl, 10h	; I/O space 0
 11509 0000412F E81A000000          <1> 	call	pci_read_reg
 11510 00004134 66A9F1FF            <1> 	test	ax, 0FFF1h
 11511 00004138 740D                <1> 	jz	short pci_get_lfb_addr_success
 11512 0000413A B214                <1> 	mov	dl, 14h ; I/O space 1

 11528                              <1> 	; (vgabios.c, 02/01/2020, vruppert)
 11529                              <1> 	;
 11530                              <1> 	; Input:
 11531                              <1> 	;	cx = device/function

 11544 00004160 80C204              <1> 	add	dl, 4 ; mov dx, 0CFCh
 11545 00004163 ED                  <1> 	in	eax, dx
 11546 00004164 C3                  <1> 	retn

 11698                              <1> dispi_set_bank_farcall:

 11734                              <1> 	out	dx, ax

  2992                                  setup_rtc_int:
  2993                                  ; source: http://wiki.osdev.org/RTC
  2994 00004165 FA                      	cli		; disable interrupts
  2995                                  	; default int frequency is 1024 Hz (Lower 4 bits of register A is 0110b or 6)
  2996                                  	; in order to change this ...
  2997                                  	; frequency  = 32768 >> (rate-1) --> 32768 >> 5 = 1024
  2998                                  	; (rate must be above 2 and not over 15)
  2999                                  	; new rate = 15 --> 32768 >> (15-1) = 2 Hz
  3000 00004166 B08A                    	mov	al, 8Ah 
  3001 00004168 E670                    	out	70h, al ; set index to register A, disable NMI
  3002 0000416A 90                      	nop
  3003 0000416B E471                    	in	al, 71h ; get initial value of register A
  3004 0000416D 88C4                    	mov 	ah, al
  3005 0000416F 80E4F0                  	and	ah, 0F0h
  3006 00004172 B08A                    	mov	al, 8Ah
  3007 00004174 E670                    	out	70h, al ; reset index to register A
  3008 00004176 88E0                    	mov	al, ah
  3009 00004178 0C0F                    	or	al, 0Fh	; new rate (0Fh -> 15)
  3010 0000417A E671                    	out	71h, al ; write only our rate to A. Note, rate is the bottom 4 bits.
  3011                                  	; enable RTC interrupt
  3012 0000417C B08B                    	mov	al, 8Bh ;
  3013 0000417E E670                    	out	70h, al ; select register B and disable NMI
  3014 00004180 90                      	nop
  3015 00004181 E471                    	in	al, 71h ; read the current value of register B
  3016 00004183 88C4                    	mov	ah, al  ;
  3017 00004185 B08B                    	mov 	al, 8Bh ;
  3018 00004187 E670                    	out	70h, al ; set the index again (a read will reset the index to register B)
  3019 00004189 88E0                    	mov	al, ah  ;
  3020 0000418B 0C40                    	or	al, 40h ;
  3021 0000418D E671                    	out	71h, al ; write the previous value ORed with 0x40. This turns on bit 6 of register B
  3022 0000418F FB                      	sti
  3023 00004190 C3                      	retn

  3105                                  	; INPUT ->
  3106                                  	; 	AL = byte (binary number)
  3107                                  	; OUTPUT ->
  3108                                  	;	AX = hexadecimal string
  3109                                  	;
  3110 00004224 53                      	push	ebx
  3111 00004225 31DB                    	xor	ebx, ebx
  3112 00004227 88C3                    	mov	bl, al
  3113 00004229 C0EB04                  	shr	bl, 4
  3114 0000422C 8A9B[72420000]          	mov	bl, [ebx+hexchrs]
  3115 00004232 86D8                    	xchg	bl, al
  3116 00004234 80E30F                  	and	bl, 0Fh
  3117 00004237 8AA3[72420000]          	mov	ah, [ebx+hexchrs]
  3118 0000423D 5B                      	pop	ebx
  3119 0000423E C3                      	retn

  3128 00004240 31DB                    	xor	ebx, ebx
  3129 00004242 86E0                    	xchg	ah, al
  3130 00004244 6650                    	push	ax ; * save ax
  3131 00004246 88E3                    	mov	bl, ah
  3132 00004248 C0EB04                  	shr	bl, 4

  3134 00004251 88E3                    	mov	bl, ah

    53                              <1> 
    54                              <1> WAITCPU_RESET_ON	EQU	21		;Reset on must last at least 14us
    55                              <1> 						;at 250 KBS xfer rate.
    56                              <1> 						;see INTEL MCS, 1985, pg. 5-456
    57                              <1> 
    58                              <1> WAITCPU_FOR_STATUS	EQU	100		;allow 30 microseconds for
    59                              <1> 						;status register to become valid
    60                              <1> 						;before re-reading.
    61                              <1> 
    62                              <1> ;After sending a byte to NEC, status register may remain
    63                              <1> ;incorrectly set for 24 us.
    64                              <1> 
    65                              <1> WAITCPU_RQM_LOW		EQU	24		;number of loops to check for
    66                              <1> 						;RQM low.

    71                              <1> ;
    72                              <1> 
    73                              <1> %macro 		SIODELAY 0 			; SHORT IODELAY
    74                              <1> 		jmp short $+2
    75                              <1> %endmacro
    76                              <1> 
    77                              <1> %macro		IODELAY  0			; NORMAL IODELAY
    78                              <1> 		jmp short $+2
    79                              <1> 		jmp short $+2
    80                              <1> %endmacro
    81                              <1> 
    82                              <1> %macro		NEWIODELAY 0
    83                              <1> 		out 0EBh, al
    84                              <1> %endmacro
