    11                              <1> ; u0.s (20/11/2015), u4.s (14/10/2015)
    12                              <1> ; ****************************************************************************
    13                              <1> ; Derived from TRDOS Operating System v1.0 (8086) source code by Erdogan Tan
    14                              <1> ; TRDOS2.ASM (09/11/2011)
    15                              <1> ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16                              <1> ; DIR.ASM (c) 2004-2011 Erdogan TAN  [07/01/2004] Last Update: 09/10/2011
    17                              <1> 
    18                              <1> set_run_sequence:
    19                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
    20                              <1> 	; 23/12/2016
    21                              <1> 	; 10/06/2016
    22                              <1> 	; 22/05/2016
    23                              <1> 	; 20/05/2016
    24                              <1> 	; 19/05/2016 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
    25                              <1> 	; TRDOS 386 feature only !
    26                              <1> 	;
    27                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
    28                              <1> 	;	AL = process number (next process)
    29                              <1> 	;
    30                              <1> 	;	this process must be added to run sequence
    31                              <1> 	;
    32                              <1> 	;	[u.pri] = priority of present process
    33                              <1> 	;
    34                              <1> 	;	DL = priority (queue)
    35                              <1> 	;	     0 = background (low) ; run on background
    36                              <1> 	;	     1 = regular (normal) ; run as regular
    37                              <1> 	;	     2 = event (high)     ; run for event
    38                              <1> 	;
    39                              <1> 	;	1) If the requested process is already running:
    40                              <1> 	;	   a) If present priority is high ([u.pri]=2)
    41                              <1> 	;	      and requested priority is also high,
    42                              <1> 	;	      there is nothing to do! Because it has been
    43                              <1> 	;	      done already (before this attempt).
    44                              <1> 	;	   b) If present priority is high ([u.pri]=2)
    45                              <1> 	;	      and requested priority is not high, there is
    46                              <1> 	;	      nothing to do! Because, it's current
    47                              <1> 	;	      run queue is unspecified, here. (It may be in
    48                              <1> 	;	      a waiting list or in a run queue; if the new
    49                              <1> 	;	      priority would be used to add it to relavant
    50                              <1>         ;             run queue, this would be wrong, unnecessary
    51                              <1> 	;	      and destabilizing duplication!)
    52                              <1> 	;	   c) If present priority is not high ([u.pri]<2)
    53                              <1>         ;             and requested priority is high (event),
    54                              <1> 	;	      process will be added to present priority's
    55                              <1> 	;	      run queue and then, priority will be changed
    56                              <1> 	;	      to high ([u.pri]=2).
    57                              <1> 	;	   d) If present priority is not high ([u.pri]<2)
    58                              <1> 	;	      and requested priority is not high, [u.pri]
    59                              <1> 	;	      value will be changed. There is nothing to do
    60                              <1> 	;	      in addition. (The new priority value will be
    61                              <1> 	;	      used by 'tswap/tswitch' procedure at 'sysret'
    62                              <1> 	;	      or 'sysrele' stage.)
    63                              <1> 	;
    64                              <1> 	;	2) If the requested process is not running:
    65                              <1> 	;	   a) If requested priority of the requested
    66                              <1> 	;	      (next) process is high (event) and priority
    67                              <1> 	;	      of present process is not high, the requested
    68                              <1> 	;	      process will be added to ('runq_event') high
    69                              <1> 	;	      priority run queue and then present (running)
    70                              <1> 	;	      process will be stopped (swapped/switched out)
    71                              <1> 	;	      immediately if it is in user mode, or it's
    72                              <1> 	;	      [u.quant] value will be reset to 0 and (then)
    73                              <1> 	;	      it will be stopped at 'sysret' stage.
    74                              <1> 	;	   b) If requested priority of the requested
    75                              <1> 	;	      (next) process is high (event) and priority
    76                              <1> 	;	      of present process is also high, the requested
    77                              <1> 	;	      process will be added to ('runq_event') high
    78                              <1> 	;	      priority run queue and present (running)
    79                              <1> 	;	      process will be allowed to run until it's
    80                              <1> 	;	      time quantum will be elapsed ([u.quant]=0).
    81                              <1> 	;	   c) If requested priority of the requested
    82                              <1> 	;	      (next) process is not high ('run for event'),
    83                              <1> 	;	      there is nothing to do. Because, it's current
    84                              <1> 	;	      run queue is unspecified, here. (It may be in
    85                              <1> 	;	      a waiting list or in a run queue; if the new
    86                              <1> 	;	      priority would be used to add it to relavant
    87                              <1>         ;             run queue, this would be wrong, unnecessary
    88                              <1> 	;	      and destabilizing duplication!)
    89                              <1> 	;
    90                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
    91                              <1> 	;	none
    92                              <1> 	;
    93                              <1> 	;	[u.pri] = priority of present process

    95                              <1> 	;	cf = 1, if the request could not be fulfilled.

    99                              <1> 	;	     if there is no process in 'run for event' queue
   100                              <1> 	;	     ('run for event' processes have higher priority)
   101                              <1> 	;	   * When [u.quant] time quantum of a process is
   102                              <1> 	;	     elapsed, it's high priority ('run for event')
   103                              <1> 	;	     status will be disabled, it can be run in sequence
   104                              <1> 	;	     of it's actual run queue.
   105                              <1> 	;	   * A 'run on background' process will always be
   106                              <1> 	;	     sequenced in 'run on background' (low priority)
   107                              <1> 	;	     queue, it can run only when other priority queues
   108                              <1> 	;	     are empty. (idle time processes, e.g. printing)

   586                              <1> sp_init:
   587                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
   588                              <1> 	; 07/11/2015
   589                              <1> 	; 29/10/2015
   590                              <1> 	; 26/10/2015
   591                              <1> 	; 23/10/2015
   592                              <1> 	; 29/06/2015
   593                              <1> 	; 14/03/2015 (Retro UNIX 386 v1 - 115200 baud)
   594                              <1> 	; 28/07/2014 (Retro UNIX 8086 v1 - 9600 baud)
   595                              <1> 	; Initialization of Serial Port Communication Parameters
   596                              <1> 	; (COM1 base port address = 3F8h, COM1 Interrupt = IRQ 4)
   597                              <1> 	; (COM2 base port address = 2F8h, COM1 Interrupt = IRQ 3)
   598                              <1> 	;
   599                              <1> 	; ((Modified registers: EAX, ECX, EDX, EBX))
   600                              <1> 	;
   601                              <1> 	; INPUT:  (29/06/2015)
   602                              <1> 	;	AL = 0 for COM1
   603                              <1> 	;	     1 for COM2
   604                              <1> 	;	AH = Communication parameters
   605                              <1> 	;
   606                              <1> 	;  (*) Communication parameters (except BAUD RATE):
   607                              <1> 	;	Bit	4	3	2	1	0
   608                              <1> 	;		-PARITY--   STOP BIT  -WORD LENGTH-
   609                              <1> 	;  this one -->	00 = none    0 = 1 bit  11 = 8 bits
   610                              <1> 	;		01 = odd     1 = 2 bits	10 = 7 bits
   611                              <1> 	;		11 = even
   612                              <1> 	;  Baud rate setting bits: (29/06/2015)
   613                              <1> 	;		Retro UNIX 386 v1 feature only !
   614                              <1> 	;	Bit	7    6    5  | Baud rate
   615                              <1> 	;		------------------------
   616                              <1> 	;	value	0    0    0  | Default (Divisor = 1)
   617                              <1> 	;		0    0    1  | 9600 (12)
   618                              <1> 	;		0    1    0  | 19200 (6)
   619                              <1> 	;		0    1	  1  | 38400 (3)
   620                              <1> 	;		1    0	  0  | 14400 (8)
   621                              <1> 	;		1    0	  1  | 28800 (4)
   622                              <1> 	;		1    1    0  | 57600 (2)
   623                              <1> 	;		1    1    1  | 115200 (1)
   624                              <1> 
   625                              <1> 	; References:
   626                              <1> 	; (1) IBM PC-XT Model 286 BIOS Source Code
   627                              <1> 	;     RS232.ASM --- 10/06/1985 COMMUNICATIONS BIOS (RS232)
   628                              <1> 	; (2) Award BIOS 1999 - ATORGS.ASM
   629                              <1> 	; (3) http://wiki.osdev.org/Serial_Ports
   630                              <1> 	;
   631                              <1> 	; Set communication parameters for COM1 (= 03h)
   632                              <1> 	;
   633                              <1> 	mov	ebx, com1p		; COM1 parameters
   634                              <1> 	mov	dx, 3F8h		; COM1
   635                              <1> 	 ; 29/10/2015
   636                              <1> 	mov	cx, 301h  ; divisor = 1 (115200 baud)
   637                              <1> 	call	sp_i3	; call A4
   638                              <1> 	test	al, 80h
   639                              <1> 	jz	short sp_i0 ; OK..
   640                              <1> 		; Error !
   641                              <1> 	;mov	dx, 3F8h
   642                              <1> 	sub	dl, 5 ; 3FDh -> 3F8h
   643                              <1> 	mov	cx, 30Eh  ; divisor = 12 (9600 baud)
   644                              <1> 	call	sp_i3	; call A4
   645                              <1> 	test	al, 80h
   646                              <1> 	jnz	short sp_i1
   647                              <1> sp_i0:
   648                              <1>         ; (Note: Serial port interrupts will be disabled here...)
   649                              <1>         ; (INT 14h initialization code disables interrupts.)
   650                              <1> 	;
   651                              <1> 	mov	byte [ebx], 0E3h ; 11100011b
   652                              <1> 	call	sp_i5 ; 29/06/2015
   653                              <1> sp_i1:
   654                              <1> 	inc	ebx
   655                              <1> 	mov	dx, 2F8h		; COM2
   656                              <1> 	 ; 29/10/2015
   657                              <1> 	mov	cx, 301h  ; divisor = 1 (115200 baud)
   658                              <1> 	call	sp_i3	; call A4
   659                              <1> 	test	al, 80h
   660                              <1> 	jz	short sp_i2 ; OK..
   661                              <1> 		; Error !
   662                              <1> 	;mov	dx, 2F8h
   663                              <1> 	sub	dl, 5 ; 2FDh -> 2F8h
   664                              <1> 	mov	cx, 30Eh  ; divisor = 12 (9600 baud)
   665                              <1> 	call	sp_i3	; call A4
   666                              <1> 	test	al, 80h
   667                              <1> 	jnz	short sp_i7
   668                              <1> sp_i2:
   669                              <1> 	mov	byte [ebx], 0E3h ; 11100011b
   670                              <1> sp_i6:
   671                              <1> 	;; COM2 - enabling IRQ 3
   672                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022
   673                              <1> 	; 07/11/2015
   674                              <1> 	; 26/10/2015
   675                              <1> 	pushf
   676                              <1> 	cli
   677                              <1> 	;
   678                              <1> 	mov	dx, 2FCh   		; modem control register
   679                              <1> 	in	al, dx 	   		; read register
   680                              <1> 	JMP	$+2	   		; I/O DELAY
   681                              <1> 	or	al, 8      		; enable bit 3 (OUT2)
   682                              <1> 	out	dx, al     		; write back to register
   683                              <1> 	JMP	$+2	   		; I/O DELAY
   684                              <1> 	;mov	dx, 2F9h   		; interrupt enable register
   685                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022
   686                              <1> 	mov	dl, 0F9h
   687                              <1> 	in	al, dx     		; read register
   688                              <1> 	JMP	$+2	   		; I/O DELAY
   689                              <1> 	;or	al, 1      		; receiver data interrupt enable and
   690                              <1> 	or	al, 3	   		; transmitter empty interrupt enable
   691                              <1> 	out	dx, al 	   		; write back to register
   692                              <1> 	JMP	$+2        		; I/O DELAY
   693                              <1> 	in	al, 21h    		; read interrupt mask register
   694                              <1> 	JMP	$+2	   		; I/O DELAY
   695                              <1> 	and	al, 0F7h   		; enable IRQ 3 (COM2)
   696                              <1> 	out	21h, al    		; write back to register
   697                              <1> 	;
   698                              <1> 	; 23/10/2015
   699                              <1> 	mov 	eax, com2_int
   700                              <1> 	mov	[com2_irq3], eax
   701                              <1> 	; 26/10/2015
   702                              <1> 	popf
   703                              <1> sp_i7:
   704                              <1> 	retn
   705                              <1> 
   706                              <1> sp_i3:
   707                              <1> ;A4:  	;-----	INITIALIZE THE COMMUNICATIONS PORT
   708                              <1> 	; 28/10/2015
   709                              <1> 	inc	dl	; 3F9h (2F9h)	; 3F9h, COM1 Interrupt enable register
   710                              <1> 	mov	al, 0
   711                              <1> 	out	dx, al			; disable serial port interrupt
   712                              <1> 	JMP	$+2			; I/O DELAY
   713                              <1> 	add	dl, 2 	; 3FBh (2FBh)	; COM1 Line control register (3FBh)
   714                              <1> 	mov	al, 80h
   715                              <1> 	out	dx, al			; SET DLAB=1 ; divisor latch access bit
   716                              <1> 	;-----	SET BAUD RATE DIVISOR
   717                              <1> 	; 26/10/2015
   718                              <1> 	sub 	dl, 3   ; 3F8h (2F8h)	; register for least significant byte
   719                              <1> 					; of the divisor value
   720                              <1> 	mov	al, cl	; 1
   721                              <1> 	out	dx, al			; 1 = 115200 baud (Retro UNIX 386 v1)
   722                              <1> 					; 2 = 57600 baud
   723                              <1> 					; 3 = 38400 baud
   724                              <1> 					; 6 = 19200 baud
   725                              <1> 					; 12 = 9600 baud (Retro UNIX 8086 v1)
   726                              <1> 	JMP	$+2			; I/O DELAY
   727                              <1> 	sub	al, al
   728                              <1> 	inc	dl      ; 3F9h (2F9h)	; register for most significant byte
   729                              <1> 					; of the divisor value
   730                              <1> 	out	dx, al ; 0
   731                              <1> 	JMP	$+2			; I/O DELAY
   732                              <1> 	;
   733                              <1> 	mov	al, ch ; 3		; 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity
   734                              <1> 	;and	al, 1Fh ; Bits 0,1,2,3,4	
   735                              <1> 	add	dl, 2	; 3FBh (2FBh)	; Line control register
   736                              <1> 	out	dx, al
   737                              <1> 	JMP	$+2			; I/O DELAY
   738                              <1> 	; 29/10/2015
   739                              <1> 	dec 	dl 	; 3FAh (2FAh)	; FIFO Control register (16550/16750)
   740                              <1> 	xor	al, al			; 0
   741                              <1> 	out	dx, al			; Disable FIFOs (reset to 8250 mode)
   742                              <1> 	JMP	$+2
   743                              <1> sp_i4:
   744                              <1> ;A18:	;-----	COMM PORT STATUS ROUTINE
   745                              <1> 	; 29/06/2015 (line status after modem status)
   746                              <1> 	add	dl, 4	; 3FEh (2FEh)	; Modem status register
   747                              <1> sp_i4s:
   748                              <1> 	in	al, dx			; GET MODEM CONTROL STATUS
   749                              <1> 	JMP	$+2			; I/O DELAY
   750                              <1> 	mov	ah, al			; PUT IN (AH) FOR RETURN
   751                              <1> 	dec	dl	; 3FDh (2FDh)	; POINT TO LINE STATUS REGISTER
   752                              <1> 					; dx = 3FDh for COM1, 2FDh for COM2
   753                              <1> 	in	al, dx			; GET LINE CONTROL STATUS
   754                              <1> 	; AL = Line status, AH = Modem status
   755                              <1> 	retn
   756                              <1> 
   757                              <1> sp_status:
   758                              <1> 	; 29/06/2015
   759                              <1> 	; 27/06/2015 (Retro UNIX 386 v1)
   760                              <1> 	; Get serial port status
   761                              <1> 	mov	dx, 3FEh		; Modem status register (COM1)
   762                              <1> 	sub	dh, al			; dh = 2 for COM2 (al = 1)
   763                              <1> 					; dx = 2FEh for COM2
   764                              <1> 	jmp	short sp_i4s
   765                              <1> 
   766                              <1> sp_setp: ; Set serial port communication parameters
   767                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
   768                              <1> 	; 07/11/2015
   769                              <1> 	; 29/10/2015
   770                              <1> 	; 29/06/2015
   771                              <1> 	; Retro UNIX 386 v1 feature only !
   772                              <1> 	;
   773                              <1> 	; INPUT:
   774                              <1> 	;	AL = 0 for COM1
   775                              <1> 	;	     1 for COM2
   776                              <1> 	;	AH = Communication parameters (*)
   777                              <1> 	; OUTPUT:
   778                              <1> 	;	CL = Line status
   779                              <1> 	;	CH = Modem status
   780                              <1> 	;   If cf = 1 -> Error code in [u.error]
   781                              <1> 	;		 'invalid parameter !'
   782                              <1> 	;		 	 or
   783                              <1> 	;		 'device not ready !' error
   784                              <1> 	;
   785                              <1> 	;  (*) Communication parameters (except BAUD RATE):
   786                              <1> 	;	Bit	4	3	2	1	0
   787                              <1> 	;		-PARITY--   STOP BIT  -WORD LENGTH-
   788                              <1> 	;  this one -->	00 = none    0 = 1 bit  11 = 8 bits
   789                              <1> 	;		01 = odd     1 = 2 bits	10 = 7 bits
   790                              <1> 	;		11 = even
   791                              <1> 	;  Baud rate setting bits: (29/06/2015)
   792                              <1> 	;		Retro UNIX 386 v1 feature only !
   793                              <1> 	;	Bit	7    6    5  | Baud rate
   794                              <1> 	;		------------------------
   795                              <1> 	;	value	0    0    0  | Default (Divisor = 1)
   796                              <1> 	;		0    0    1  | 9600 (12)
   797                              <1> 	;		0    1    0  | 19200 (6)
   798                              <1> 	;		0    1	  1  | 38400 (3)
   799                              <1> 	;		1    0	  0  | 14400 (8)
   800                              <1> 	;		1    0	  1  | 28800 (4)
   801                              <1> 	;		1    1    0  | 57600 (2)
   802                              <1> 	;		1    1    1  | 115200 (1)
   803                              <1> 	;
   804                              <1> 	; (COM1 base port address = 3F8h, COM1 Interrupt = IRQ 4)
   805                              <1> 	; (COM2 base port address = 2F8h, COM1 Interrupt = IRQ 3)
   806                              <1> 	;
   807                              <1> 	; ((Modified registers: EAX, ECX, EDX, EBX))
   808                              <1> 	;
   809                              <1> 	mov	dx, 3F8h
   810                              <1> 	mov	ebx, com1p ; COM1 control byte offset
   811                              <1> 	cmp	al, 1
   812                              <1> 	ja 	short sp_invp_err
   813                              <1> 	jb	short sp_setp1 ;  COM1 (AL = 0)
   814                              <1> 	dec	dh ; 2F8h
   815                              <1> 	inc	ebx ; COM2 control byte offset
   816                              <1> sp_setp1:
   817                              <1> 	; 29/10/2015
   818                              <1> 	mov	[ebx], ah
   819                              <1> 	movzx 	ecx, ah
   820                              <1> 	shr	cl, 5 ; -> baud rate index
   821                              <1> 	and	ah, 1Fh ; communication parameters except baud rate
   822                              <1> 	mov	al, [ecx+b_div_tbl]
   823                              <1> 	mov	cx, ax
   824                              <1> 	call	sp_i3
   825                              <1> 	mov	cx, ax ; CL = Line status, CH = Modem status
   826                              <1> 	test	al, 80h
   827                              <1> 	jz	short sp_setp2
   828                              <1>         mov     byte [ebx], 0E3h ; Reset to initial value (11100011b)
   829                              <1> stp_dnr_err:
   830                              <1> 	mov	dword [u.error], ERR_DEV_NOT_RDY ; 'device not ready !'
   831                              <1> 	; CL = Line status, CH = Modem status

   934                              <1> 	;
   935                              <1> 	; TRDOS v1.0 (DIR.ASM, "proc_set_working_path")
   936                              <1> 	; 27/01/2011 - 08/02/2011 
   937                              <1> 	; Set/Changes current drive, directory and file
   938                              <1> 	; depending on command tail
   939                              <1> 	; (procedure is derivated from CMD_INTR.ASM
   940                              <1> 	; file or dir locating code of internal commands)
   941                              <1> 	; (This procedure is prepared for INT 21H file/dir
   942                              <1> 	; functions and also to get compact code for
   943                              <1> 	; internal mainprog -command interpreter- commands)
   944                              <1> 	;
   945                              <1> 	; INPUT: DS:SI -> Command tail (ASCIIZ string)
   946                              <1> 	; AL = 0 -> any, AL > 0 -> file name is forced
   947                              <1> 	; AH = CD -> Change directory permanently
   948                              <1> 	; AH <> CD -> Change directory as temporary
   949                              <1> 	;
   950                              <1> 	; OUTPUT: ES=DS, FindFile structure has been set
   951                              <1> 	;        RUN_CDRV points previous current drive
   952                              <1> 	;        DS:SI = FindFile structure address
   953                              <1> 	;        (DS=CS)
   954                              <1> 	;        AX, BX, CX, DX, DI will be changed
   955                              <1> 	;   cf = 1 -> Error code in AX (AL)
   956                              <1> 	;        stc & AX = 0 -> Bad command or path name
   957                              <1> 	; -----------------------------------------------
   958                              <1> 	;
   959                              <1> 	; TRDOS 386 (05/10/2016)
   960                              <1> 	; INPUT:
   961                              <1> 	;	ESI = File/Directory Path (ASCIIZ string)
   962                              <1> 	;             address in user's memory space
   963                              <1> 	;       AL = 0 -> any
   964                              <1> 	;       AL > 0 -> file name is forced
   965                              <1> 	;       AH = CD -> change directory as permanent
   966                              <1> 	;       AH <> CD -> change directory as temporary
   967                              <1> 	;
   968                              <1> 	; OUTPUT:
   969                              <1> 	;	FindFile structure has been set
   970                              <1> 	;       RUN_CDRV points previous current drive
   971                              <1> 	;       ESI = FindFile_Name address ; 12/10/2016
   972                              <1> 	;
   973                              <1> 	;       cf = 1 -> Error code in EAX (AL)
   974                              <1> 	;       stc & EAX = 0 -> Bad command or path name
   975                              <1> 	;
   976                              <1> 	; Modified registers: EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX, ESI, EDI
   977                              <1>

  1641                              <1> set_IRQ_callback_addr:
  1642                              <1> 	;
  1643                              <1> 	; This routine sets return address
  1644                              <1> 	; to start of user's interrupt
  1645                              <1> 	; service (callback) address
  1646                              <1> 	;
  1647                              <1> 	; INPUT:
  1648                              <1> 	;	EDX = callback routine/service address
  1649                              <1> 	;	      (virtual, not physical address!)
  1650                              <1> 	;	[u.sp] = kernel stack, points to
  1651                              <1> 	;		 user's EIP,CS,EFLAGS,ESP,SS
  1652                              <1> 	;		 registers.
  1653                              <1> 	; OUTPUT:
  1654                              <1> 	;	EIP (user) = callback (service) address
  1655                              <1> 	;	CS (user) = UCODE
  1656                              <1> 	;	EFLAGS (user) = flags before callback
  1657                              <1> 	;       ESP (user) = ESP-4 (user, before callback)
  1658                              <1> 	;	[ESP](user) = EIP (user) before callback
  1659                              <1> 	;
  1660                              <1> 	; Note: If CPU was in user mode while entering
  1661                              <1> 	;	the timer interrupt service routine,
  1662                              <1> 	;	'IRET' will get return to callback routine
  1663                              <1> 	;	immediately. If CPU was in system/kernel mode
  1664                              <1> 	;	'iret' will get return to system call and
  1665                              <1> 	;	then, callback routine will be return address
  1666                              <1> 	;	from system call. (User's callback/service code
  1667                              <1> 	;	will be able to return to normal return address
  1668                              <1> 	;	via a 'sysrele' system call at the end.)
  1669                              <1> 	;
  1670                              <1> 	; Note: User's IRQ callback service code must be ended
  1671                              <1> 	;	with a 'sysrele' system call !
  1672                              <1> 	;
  1673                              <1> 	;	For example:
  1674                              <1> 	;
  1675                              <1> 	;	audio_IRQ_callback:
  1676                              <1> 	;	    ...
  1677                              <1> 	;	    <load DMA buffer with audio data>
  1678                              <1> 	;	    ...
  1679                              <1> 	;	    mov eax, 39 ; 'sysrele'
  1680                              <1> 	;	    int 40h ; TRDOS 386 system call (interrupt)
  1681                              <1> 	;
  1682                              <1> 
  1683                              <1> 	;mov	edx, [edx+IRQ.addr] ; Callback service address
  1684                              <1> 	;			    ; (Virtual address)

  2050                              <1> sysaudio: ; AUDIO FUNCTIONS
  2051                              <1> 	; 28/01/2025
  2052                              <1> 	; 27/01/2025
  2053                              <1> 	; 15/01/2025
  2054                              <1> 	; 12/01/2025
  2055                              <1> 	; 11/01/2025 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.10)
  2056                              <1> 	; 29/12/2024
  2057                              <1> 	; 19/12/2024
  2058                              <1> 	; 23/08/2024 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.9)
  2059                              <1> 	; 05/06/2024
  2060                              <1> 	; 04/06/2024
  2061                              <1> 	; 23/05/2024 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.8)
  2062                              <1>  	; 19/11/2023 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.7)
  2063                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.5)
  2064                              <1> 	; 12/02/2021 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.3)
  2065                              <1> 	; 28/07/2020
  2066                              <1> 	; 27/07/2020
  2067                              <1> 	; 10/10/2017
  2068                              <1> 	; 22/06/2017
  2069                              <1> 	; 28/05/2017, 04/06/2017, 05/06/2017, 10/06/2017
  2070                              <1> 	; 01/05/2017, 12/05/2017, 15/05/2017, 20/05/2017
  2071                              <1> 	; 21/04/2017, 22/04/2017, 23/04/2017, 24/04/2017
  2072                              <1> 	; 10/04/2017, 13/04/2017, 14/04/2017, 16/04/2017
  2073                              <1> 	; 03/04/2017 (VIA VT8237R)
  2074                              <1> 	; 01/04/2016 (trdosk6.s -> tdosk8.s)
  2075                              <1> 	; 16/05/2016 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  2076                              <1> 	;
  2077                              <1> 	; Inputs:
  2078                              <1> 	;
  2079                              <1> 	;	BH = 0 -> Beep (PC Speaker)
  2080                              <1> 	;	     BL = Duration Counter (1 for 1/64 second)
  2081                              <1> 	;	     CX = Frequency Divisor (1193180/Frequency)
  2082                              <1> 	;		 (1331 for 886 Hz)
  2083                              <1> 	;
  2084                              <1> 	;	01/04/2017
  2085                              <1> 	;
  2086                              <1> 	; 	BH = 1 -> DETECT (& ENABLE) AUDIO DEVICE
  2087                              <1> 	;	     BL = 0 : PC SPEAKER
  2088                              <1> 	;		  1 : SOUND BLASTER 16
  2089                              <1> 	;		  2 : INTEL AC'97
  2090                              <1> 	;		  3 : VIA VT8237R (VT8233)
  2091                              <1> 	;		  4 : INTEL HDA
  2092                              <1> 	;	      5-FEh : unknown/invalid
  2093                              <1> 	;	        ; 04/06/2017
  2094                              <1> 	;		FFh : Get current audio device id
  2095                              <1> 	;
  2096                              <1> 	; 	BH = 2 -> ALLOCATE AUDIO BUFFER (for user)
  2097                              <1> 	;		ECX = Audio Buffer Size (must be equal to
  2098                              <1> 	;		      the half of DMA buffer size)
  2099                              <1> 	;		EDX = Virtual Address of the buffer
  2100                              <1> 	;		      (This is not DMA buffer!)
  2101                              <1> 	;
  2102                              <1> 	;	BH = 3 -> INITIALIZE AUDIO DEVICE
  2103                              <1> 	;	     BL = 0,2 -> for Signal Response Byte
  2104                              <1> 	;	     	CL = Signal Response Byte Value (fixed)
  2105                              <1> 	;				if BL = 0
  2106                              <1> 	;	             auto increment of S.R.B. value
  2107                              <1> 	;			 	if BL = 2
  2108                              <1> 	;	        EDX = Signal Response (Return) Byte Address
  2109                              <1> 	;
  2110                              <1> 	;	     BL = 1 for CallBack Method
  2111                              <1> 	;	    	EDX = CallBack Service Address (Virtual)
  2112                              <1> 	;
  2113                              <1> 	;	     BL > 2 -> invalid function
  2114                              <1> 	;
  2115                              <1> 	;	    (Audio buffer must be allocated before
  2116                              <1> 	;	     initialization.)
  2117                              <1> 	;
  2118                              <1> 	;	BH = 4 -> START TO PLAY
  2119                              <1> 	;	     BL = Mode
  2120                              <1> 	;		  Bit 0 = mono/stereo (1 = stereo)
  2121                              <1> 	;		  Bit 1 = 8 bit / 16 bit (1 = 16 bit)
  2122                              <1> 	;	     CX = Sampling Rate (Hz)
  2123                              <1> 	;
  2124                              <1> 	;	BH = 5 -> PAUSE
  2125                              <1> 	;	     BL = Any
  2126                              <1> 	;
  2127                              <1> 	;	BH = 6 -> CONTINUE TO PLAY
  2128                              <1> 	;	     BL = Any
  2129                              <1> 	;
  2130                              <1> 	;	BH = 7 -> STOP
  2131                              <1> 	;	     BL = Any
  2132                              <1> 	;
  2133                              <1> 	;	BH = 8 -> RESET
  2134                              <1> 	;	     BL = Any
  2135                              <1> 	;
  2136                              <1> 	;	BH = 9 -> CANCEL (CALLBACK or S.R.B. SERVICE)
  2137                              <1> 	;	     BL = Any
  2138                              <1> 	;
  2139                              <1> 	;	BH = 10 -> DEALLOCATE AUDIO BUFFER (for user)
  2140                              <1> 	;	     BL = Any
  2141                              <1> 	;
  2142                              <1> 	;	BH = 11 -> SET VOLUME LEVEL
  2143                              <1> 	;	     BL: (Bit 0 to 6)
  2144                              <1> 	;		  0 = Master (Playback, Lineout) volume
  2145                              <1> 	;		  1 = PCM out volume ; 23/05/2024
  2146                              <1> 	;	     CL = Left Channel Volume (0 to 31 max)
  2147                              <1> 	;	     CH = Right Channel Volume (0 to 31 max)
  2148                              <1> 	;
  2149                              <1> 	;	     Note: If BL >= 80h (Bit 7 of BL is set),
  2150                              <1> 	;	     volume level will be set for next playing
  2151                              <1> 	;	     (actual volume level will not be changed
  2152                              <1> 	;	     immediately)
  2153                              <1> 	;
  2154                              <1> 	;	BH = 12 -> DISABLE AUDIO DEVICE
  2155                              <1> 	;	     (reset audio device and unlink dma buffer)
  2156                              <1> 	;	     BL = Any
  2157                              <1> 	;
  2158                              <1> 	;    	12/05/2017
  2159                              <1> 	;	BH = 13 -> MAP DMA BUFFER TO USER
  2160                              <1> 	;	    (for direct access to system's dma buffer)
  2161                              <1> 	;
  2162                              <1> 	;	     ECX = map size in bytes
  2163                              <1> 	;		  (will be rounded up to page borders)
  2164                              <1> 	;	     EDX = Virtual Address of the buffer
  2165                              <1> 	;		  (Will be rounded up to page borders)
  2166                              <1> 	;
  2167                              <1> 	;	05/06/2017
  2168                              <1> 	;    	04/06/2017
  2169                              <1> 	;	BH = 14 -> GET AUDIO DEVICE INFO
  2170                              <1> 	;	     BL: 0 = Audio Controller Info
  2171                              <1> 	;	     ; 19/11/2023
  2172                              <1> 	;	     BL: 1 = Audio (AC'97) Codec Info
  2173                              <1> 	;	     BL > 1 = Invalid for now!
  2174                              <1> 	;
  2175                              <1> 	;	22/06/2017
  2176                              <1> 	;	BH = 15 -> GET CURRENT SOUND DATA (for graphics)
  2177                              <1> 	;	     BL: 0 -> PCM OUT data
  2178                              <1> 	;	       > 0 -> Invalid for now!
  2179                              <1> 	;	     ECX = 0 -> Get DMA Buffer Pointer
  2180                              <1> 	;		 EDX = Not Used
  2181                              <1> 	;	     ECX > 0 -> Byte count for buffer (EDX)
  2182                              <1> 	;	         EDX = Buffer Address (Virtual)
  2183                              <1> 	;
  2184                              <1> 	;	10/10/2017
  2185                              <1> 	;	BH = 16 -> UPDATE DMA BUFFER DATA
  2186                              <1> 	;		   (by using the Audio Buffer content)
  2187                              <1> 	;	     BL = 0 : Update dma half buffer in sequence
  2188                              <1> 	;		      (automatic destination)
  2189                              <1> 	;		  1 : Update 1st half of the dma buffer
  2190                              <1> 	;		  2 : Update 2nd half of the dma buffer
  2191                              <1> 	;		  3-FEh: Invalid!
  2192                              <1> 	;		  FFh = Get current flag value
  2193                              <1> 	;			(Half buffer number -1)
  2194                              <1> 	;
  2195                              <1> 	;	24/05/2024
  2196                              <1> 	;	BH = 17 -> GET VOLUME LEVEL
  2197                              <1> 	;	     BL:  0 = Master (Playback, Lineout) volume
  2198                              <1> 	;		  1 = PCM out volume
  2199                              <1> 	;
  2200                              <1> 	; Outputs:
  2201                              <1> 	;
  2202                              <1> 	;	For BH = 0 -> Beep
  2203                              <1> 	;	    None
  2204                              <1> 	;
  2205                              <1> 	;	01/04/2017
  2206                              <1> 	;
  2207                              <1> 	; 	For BH = 1 -> DETECT (& ENABLE) AUDIO DEVICE
  2208                              <1> 	;	    AH = 0 : PC SPEAKER
  2209                              <1> 	;		 1 : SOUND BLASTER 16
  2210                              <1> 	;		 2 : INTEL AC'97
  2211                              <1> 	;		 3 : VIA VT8237R (VT8233)
  2212                              <1> 	;		 4 : INTEL HDA
  2213                              <1> 	;	      5-FFh : unknown/invalid
  2214                              <1> 	;	    AL = mode status
  2215                              <1> 	;		 bit 0 = mono /stereo (1 = stereo)
  2216                              <1> 	;		 bit 1 = 8 bit / 16 bit (1 = 16 bit)
  2217                              <1> 	;	    04/06/2017
  2218                              <1> 	;	    EBX = PCI DEVICE/VENDOR ID (if >0)
  2219                              <1> 	;		 (BX = VENDOR ID) 
  2220                              <1> 	;	    (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2221                              <1> 	;
  2222                              <1> 	; 	For BH = 2 -> ALLOCATE AUDIO BUFFER (for user)
  2223                              <1> 	;	    EAX = Physical Address of the buffer
  2224                              <1> 	;	    (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2225                              <1> 	;
  2226                              <1> 	;	For BH = 3 -> INITIALIZE AUDIO DEVICE
  2227                              <1> 	;	    (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2228                              <1> 	;
  2229                              <1> 	;	For BH = 4 -> START TO PLAY
  2230                              <1> 	;	    none (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2231                              <1> 	;
  2232                              <1> 	;	For BH = 5 -> PAUSE
  2233                              <1> 	;	    none (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2234                              <1> 	;
  2235                              <1> 	;	For BH = 6 -> CONTINUE TO PLAY
  2236                              <1> 	;	    none (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2237                              <1> 	;
  2238                              <1> 	;	For BH = 7 -> STOP
  2239                              <1> 	;	    none (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2240                              <1> 	;
  2241                              <1> 	;	For BH = 8 -> RESET
  2242                              <1> 	;	    none (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2243                              <1> 	;
  2244                              <1> 	;	For BH = 9 -> CANCEL (CALLBACK or S.R.B. SERVICE)
  2245                              <1> 	;	    none (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2246                              <1> 	;
  2247                              <1> 	;	For BH = 10 -> DEALLOCATE AUDIO BUFFER (for user)
  2248                              <1> 	;	    none (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2249                              <1> 	;
  2250                              <1> 	;	For BH = 11 -> SET VOLUME LEVEL
  2251                              <1> 	;	    none (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2252                              <1> 	;
  2253                              <1> 	;	For BH = 12 -> DISABLE AUDIO DEVICE
  2254                              <1> 	;	    none (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2255                              <1> 	;
  2256                              <1> 	;    	12/05/2017
  2257                              <1> 	;	For BH = 13 -> MAP DMA BUFFER TO USER
  2258                              <1> 	;	    EAX = Physical Address of the buffer
  2259                              <1> 	;	    (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2260                              <1> 	;
  2261                              <1> 	;    	04/06/2017
  2262                              <1> 	;	For BH = 14 -> GET AUDIO DEVICE INFO
  2263                              <1> 	;	(for BL = 0) ; 05/06/2017
  2264                              <1> 	;	    EAX = IRQ Number in AL
  2265                              <1> 	;		  Audio Device Number in AH
  2266                              <1> 	;	    EBX = DEV/VENDOR ID
  2267                              <1> 	;		 (DDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDVVVVVVVVVVVVVVVV)
  2268                              <1> 	;	    ECX = BUS/DEV/FN 
  2269                              <1> 	;		 (00000000BBBBBBBBDDDDDFFF00000000)
  2270                              <1> 	;	    EDX = NABMBAR/NAMBAR (for AC97)
  2271                              <1> 	;		  (Low word, DX = NAMBAR address)
  2272                              <1> 	;	    EDX = Base IO Addr (DX) for SB16 & VT8233
  2273                              <1> 	;	    (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2274                              <1> 	;	                 (ERR_DEV_NOT_RDY = 15)
  2275                              <1> 	;	(for BL = 1) -for AC97- ; 19/11/2023
  2276                              <1> 	;	    EAX = Extended Audio ID (MX28) in AX
  2277                              <1> 	;	     AX bit 0 - VRA bit
  2278                              <1> 	;	     HW of EAX = PCM output sample rate (HZ)
  2279                              <1> 	;	    EBX = VENDOR ID 1 (BX), VENDOR ID 2 (HW)
  2280                              <1> 	;	    (if CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX)
  2281                              <1> 	;	                 (ERR_DEV_NOT_RDY = 15)
  2282                              <1> 	;	    Note: EAX & EBX = 0 (for SB16,VIA,HDA)
  2283                              <1>  	;
  2284                              <1> 	;	22/06/2017
  2285                              <1> 	;	For BH = 15 -> GET CURRENT SOUND DATA
  2286                              <1> 	;			 (for graphics)
  2287                              <1> 	;	(for BL = 0)
  2288                              <1> 	;	 If ECX input is 0
  2289                              <1> 	;	    EAX = DMA Buffer Current Position (Offset)
  2290                              <1> 	;	 If ECX input >  0
  2291                              <1> 	;	    EAX = Actual transfer count
  2292                              <1> 	;	    (Sound samples will be copied from
  2293                              <1> 	;	     Current DMA Buffer Position to EDX
  2294                              <1> 	;	     virtual address as EAX bytes.)
  2295                              <1> 	;	 ((If CF = 1 ->  Error code in EAX))
  2296                              <1> 	;
  2297                              <1> 	;	10/10/2017
  2298                              <1> 	;	For BH = 16 -> UPDATE DMA BUFFER DATA
  2299                              <1> 	;	    EAX = 0, if the updated (or current)

  3767                              <1> sound_update:
  3768                              <1> 	; FUNCTION = 16
  3769                              <1> 	; bl =
  3770                              <1> 	;    0 = automatic (sequental) update (with flag switch!)
  3771                              <1> 	;    1 = update dma half buffer 1 (without flag switch!)
  3772                              <1> 	;    2 = update dma half buffer 2 (without flag switch!)
  3773                              <1> 	;  FFh = get current flag value
  3774                              <1> 	;      0 = dma half buffer 1 (will be played next)
  3775                              <1> 	;      1 = dma half buffer 2 (will be played next)
  3776                              <1> 	;
  3777                              <1> 	; 29/12/2024
  3778                              <1> 	; Note:	Requested half buffer is updated and
  3779                              <1> 	;	flag is set to other value for other half buffer
  3780                              <1> 	;
  3781                              <1> 	; For example:
  3782                              <1> 	;     *	if BL input is 1, half buffer 1 is loaded and
  3783                              <1> 	;	   flag is switched to 1 -half buff 2 is in order-
  3784                              <1> 	;     (next time half buffer 2 is updated automaticly)
  3785                              <1> 	;     *	if BL input is 2, half buffer 2 is updated/loaded
  3786                              <1> 	;	   and flag is switched to 0

  3788                              <1> 	; Return value for BL input = 0,1,2

  3792                              <1> 	;     IF BL input is 2, return value will be 0 (1 xor 1)

  3964                              <1> set_irq_callback_service:
  3965                              <1> 	; 23/11/2023
  3966                              <1> 	; 20/11/2023 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.7)
  3967                              <1> 	; 30/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
  3968                              <1> 	; 03/08/2020
  3969                              <1> 	; 10/06/2017
  3970                              <1> 	; 12/05/2017
  3971                              <1> 	; 24/04/2017
  3972                              <1> 	; 22/04/2017
  3973                              <1> 	; caller: 'syscalbac' or 'sysaudio' or ...
  3974                              <1> 	; 13/04/2017, 14/04/2017, 17/04/2017
  3975                              <1> 	; 24/02/2017, 26/02/2017, 28/02/2017
  3976                              <1> 	; 21/02/2017 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  3977                              <1> 	;
  3978                              <1> 	; Link or unlink IRQ callback service to/from user (ring 3)
  3979                              <1> 	;
  3980                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  3981                              <1> 	;	If AL = 0, the caller is 'syscalbac';
  3982                              <1> 	;	   otherwise, the caller is 'sysaudio' or ...
  3983                              <1> 	;	   (AL = user number)
  3984                              <1> 	;
  3985                              <1> 	;	BL = IRQ number (Hardware interrupt request number)
  3986                              <1> 	;	     (0 to 15 but IRQ 0,1,2,6,8,14,15 are prohibited)
  3987                              <1> 	;	     IRQ numbers 3,4,5,7,9,10,11,12,13 are valid
  3988                              <1> 	;	     (numbers >15 are invalid)
  3989                              <1> 	;
  3990                              <1> 	;	BH = 0 = Unlink IRQ (in BL) from user (ring 3) service
  3991                              <1> 	;	     1 = Link IRQ by using Signal Response Byte method
  3992                              <1> 	;	     2 = Link IRQ by using Callback service method
  3993                              <1> 	;	     3 = Link IRQ by using Auto Increment S.R.B. method
  3994                              <1> 	;	    >3 = invalid
  3995                              <1> 	;		 (syscallback version will return to user)
  3996                              <1> 	;
  3997                              <1> 	;	CL = Signal Return/Response Byte value
  3998                              <1> 	;
  3999                              <1> 	;	If BH = 3, kernel will put a counter value ; 03/08/2020
  4000                              <1> 	;	          (into the S.R.B. addr)
  4001                              <1> 	;		  between 0 to 255. (start value = CL+1)
  4002                              <1> 	;
  4003                              <1> 	;	NOTE: counter value, for example: even and odd numbers
  4004                              <1> 	;	      may be used for -audio- DMA buffer switch
  4005                              <1> 	;	      within double buffer method, etc.
  4006                              <1> 	;
  4007                              <1> 	;	EDX = Signal return (Response) byte address
  4008                              <1> 	;	       		  - or -
  4009                              <1> 	;	      Interrupt/Callback service/routine address
  4010                              <1> 	;
  4011                              <1> 	;	      (virtual address in user's memory space)
  4012                              <1> 	;
  4013                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
  4014                              <1> 	;	CF = 0 & EAX = 0 -> Successful setting
  4015                              <1> 	;	CF = 1 & EAX > 0 -> IRQ is prohibited or locked
  4016                              <1> 	;			by another process
  4017                              <1> 	;		 eax = ERR_PERM_DENIED -> prohibited or locked
  4018                              <1> 	;		 eax = ERR_INV_PARAMETER ->
  4019                              <1> 	;		       invalid parameter/option or bad address
  4020                              <1> 	;
  4021                              <1> 	; TRDOS 386 - IRQ CALLBACK structures (parameters):
  4022                              <1> 	;
  4023                              <1> 	;	   [u.irqlock]	: 1 word, IRQ flags (0-15) that indicates
  4024                              <1> 	;			which IRQs are locked by (that) user.
  4025                              <1> 	;		        Lock and unlock (by user) will change
  4026                              <1> 	;			these flags or 'terminate process' (sysexit)
  4027                              <1> 	;			will clear these flags and unlock those IRQs.
  4028                              <1> 	;
  4029                              <1> 	;		   	Bit 0 is for IRQ 0 and Bit 15 is for IRQ 15
  4030                              <1> 	;
  4031                              <1> 	;	   IRQ(x).owner	: 1 byte, user, [u.uno], 0 = free (unlocked)
  4032                              <1> 	;
  4033                              <1> 	;	   IRQ(x).method : 1 byte for callback method & status
  4034                              <1> 	;			   0 = Signal Response Byte method
  4035                              <1> 	;			   1 = Callback service method
  4036                              <1> 	;			   >1 = invalid for current 'syscalback'.
  4037                              <1> 	;			or(+) 80h = IRQ is in use by system (ring 0)
  4038                              <1> 	;			            function (audio etc.) or
  4039                              <1> 	;			   	    a device driver.
  4040                              <1> 	;			(system function will ignore the lock/owner)
  4041                              <1> 	;
  4042                              <1> 	;	   IRQ(x).srb	: 1 byte, Signal Return/Response byte value
  4043                              <1> 	;			  (a fixed value by user or a counter value
  4044                              <1> 	;			 from 0 to 255, which is increased by every
  4045                              <1> 	;			 interrupt just before putting it into
  4046                              <1> 	;			 the Signal Response byte address)
  4047                              <1> 	;			 (This is not used in callback serv method)
  4048                              <1> 	;
  4049                              <1> 	;	   IRQ(x).addr	: 1 dword
  4050                              <1> 	;			  Signal Response Byte address (physical)
  4051                              <1> 	;			  		-or-
  4052                              <1> 	;			  Callback service address (virtual)
  4053                              <1> 	;
  4054                              <1> 	;	   IRQ(x).dev	: 1 byte
  4055                              <1> 	;			  0 = Default device or kernel function
  4056                              <1> 	;			  		-or-
  4057                              <1> 	;			  1-255 = Assigned device driver number
  4058                              <1> 	;
  4059                              <1> 	;	   (x) = 3,4,5,7,9,10,11,12,13
  4060                              <1> 	;
  4061                              <1> 
  4062 0001428E 80FB0F              <1> 	cmp	bl, 15
  4063 00014291 7727                <1> 	ja	short scbs_2
  4064                              <1> 
  4065 00014293 80FF03              <1> 	cmp	bh, 3
  4066 00014296 7722                <1> 	ja	short scbs_2  ; invalid parameter
  4067                              <1> 
  4068 00014298 0FB6FB              <1> 	movzx	edi, bl ; save IRQ number
  4069                              <1> 
  4070                              <1> 		; IRQ 0,1,2,6,8,14,15 are prohibited
  4071                              <1> 	;IRQenum: ; 'trdosk9.s'
  4072                              <1> 	;	db  0,0,0,1,2,3,0,4,0,5,6,7,8,9,0,0
  4073                              <1> 
  4074 0001429B 0FB6B7[A0500100]    <1> 	movzx	esi, byte [edi+IRQenum] ; IRQ availability
  4075                              <1> 					; enumeration/index
  4076                              <1> 	; 20/11/2023
  4077 000142A2 4E                  <1> 	dec	esi
  4078                              <1> 	;dec	si
  4079 000142A3 780F                <1> 	js	short scbs_1 ;  0 -> 0FFFFh
  4080                              <1> 
  4081                              <1> 	; ESI = IRQ callback parameters index number (0 to 8)
  4082                              <1> 
  4083 000142A5 08FF                <1> 	or	bh, bh

  4227                              <1> sysdma: ; DMA FUNCTIONS
  4228                              <1> 	; 08/08/2022
  4229                              <1> 	; 30/07/2022 - TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5
  4230                              <1> 	; 02/09/2017
  4231                              <1> 	; 28/08/2017
  4232                              <1> 	; 20/08/2017 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  4233                              <1> 	;
  4234                              <1> 	; Inputs:
  4235                              <1> 	;	BH = 0 -> Allocate DMA buffer
  4236                              <1> 	;	   BL = 0 -> Use the system's default DMA
  4237                              <1> 	;		     (SB16) Buffer
  4238                              <1> 	;	        Buffer Size (max.) = 65536 bytes
  4239                              <1> 	;	   BL > 0 -> Allocate (a new) DMA buffer
  4240                              <1>  	;	   ECX = DMA Buffer Size in bytes (<=128KB)
  4241                              <1> 	;	   EDX = Virtual Address of DMA buffer
  4242                              <1> 	;
  4243                              <1> 	;	BH = 1 -> Initialize (Start) DMA service
  4244                              <1> 	;	     BL, bit 0 to 3 = Channel Number (0 to 7)
  4245                              <1> 	;	     BL, bit 7 = Auto Initialized Mode
  4246                              <1> 	;			(If bit 7 is set)
  4247                              <1> 	;		 bit 6 = Record (read) mode (0= playback)
  4248                              <1> 	;	     ECX = byte count (0 = use dma buffer size)
  4249                              <1> 	;	     EDX = physical buffer address
  4250                              <1> 	;	     	   (0 = use dma buffer -start- address)
  4251                              <1> 	;
  4252                              <1> 	;	BH = 2 -> Get Current DMA Buffer Offset
  4253                              <1> 	;	     BL = DMA channel number
  4254                              <1> 	;
  4255                              <1> 	;	BH = 3 -> Get Current DMA count down value
  4256                              <1> 	;	     BL = DMA channel number (0 tO 7)
  4257                              <1> 	;
  4258                              <1> 	;	BH = 4 -> Get Current DMA channel (in progress)
  4259                              <1> 	;
  4260                              <1> 	;	BH = 5 -> Get System's Default DMA Buffer Address
  4261                              <1> 	;
  4262                              <1> 	;	BH = 6 -> Get Current DMA Buffer Address
  4263                              <1> 	;
  4264                              <1> 	;	BH = 7 -> Stop DMA service
  4265                              <1> 	;
  4266                              <1> 	; Outputs:
  4267                              <1> 	;
  4268                              <1> 	;	For BH = 0 ; Allocate DMA buffer
  4269                              <1> 	;	    EAX = Physical address of DMA buffer
  4270                              <1> 	;	    ECX = Allocated buffer size in bytes
  4271                              <1> 	;		  - page count * 4096 -
  4272                              <1> 	;		  (may be bigger than requested)
  4273                              <1> 	;	    If BL input > 0,
  4274                              <1> 	;	       'sysalloc:' system call will be used with
  4275                              <1>   	;	       EBX (for 'sysalloc') = EDX (for 'sysdma')
  4276                              <1> 	;	       ECX is same, byte count (buffer size)
  4277                              <1> 	;	       EDX = 1024*1024*16 ; 16 MB upper limit
  4278                              <1> 	;	    If BL input = 0,
  4279                              <1> 	;	       Default DMA buffer (SB16 buffer) will be
  4280                              <1> 	;	       checked and if it is free, it's address
  4281                              <1> 	;	       will be returned in EAX and it's size
  4282                              <1> 	;	       will be returned in ECX (as 65536)
  4283                              <1> 	;
  4284                              <1> 	;	    If CF = 1, error code is in EAX
  4285                              <1> 	;	       EAX = -1 ; DMA buffer allocation error!
  4286                              <1> 	;	       EAX = 11 ; 'Permission Denied' error !
  4287                              <1> 	;
  4288                              <1> 	;	       Note: 'sysalloc' error return method
  4289                              <1> 	;		      will be applied if BL input > 0 !
  4290                              <1> 	;
  4291                              <1> 	; 	 For BH = 1 ; Initialize (Start) DMA
  4292                              <1> 	;	     EAX = 0 (Successful)
  4293                              <1> 	;	     If CF = 1, error code is in EAX
  4294                              <1> 	;
  4295                              <1> 	; 	 For BH = 2 ; Get Current DMA Buffer Offset
  4296                              <1> 	;	     EAX = DMA Buffer Offset (in bytes)
  4297                              <1> 	;	     ;
  4298                              <1> 	;	      AX = DMA buffer offset
  4299                              <1> 	;	     EAX bits 16 to 23 = Page register value
  4300                              <1> 	;
  4301                              <1> 	; 	 For BH = 3 ; Get Current DMA count down value
  4302                              <1> 	;	     EAX = Count down value (remain bytes)
  4303                              <1> 	;
  4304                              <1> 	;	 For BH = 4 ; Get Current DMA channel (in progress)
  4305                              <1> 	;	     EAX = DMA channel number (0 to 7)
  4306                              <1> 	;		AH = 0 if the owner is the caller process
  4307                              <1> 	;		AH > 0 if the dma channel is in use by
  4308                              <1> 	;		       another user/process
  4309                              <1> 	;	     EAX = -1 (0FFFFFFFFh)
  4310                              <1> 	;		    if DMA service is not in use
  4311                              <1> 	;	 	    (stopped or not initialized/started)
  4312                              <1> 	;
  4313                              <1> 	;	 For BH = 5 ; Get System's Default DMA Buff Addr
  4314                              <1> 	;	     EAX = Default DMA Buffer Address (Physical)
  4315                              <1> 	;		 = offset 'sb16_dma_buffer:'
  4316                              <1> 	;	     ECX = Buffer size
  4317                              <1> 	;		 = 65536
  4318                              <1> 	;
  4319                              <1> 	;	 For BH = 6 ; Get Current DMA Buffer Address
  4320                              <1> 	;	     EAX = Current DMA buffer address (Physical)
  4321                              <1> 	;	     ECX = Current DMA buffer size (setting value)
  4322                              <1> 	;	     Note: These values are for current dma channel
  4323                              <1> 	;		   settings for the user/process
  4324                              <1> 	;	     ** For now (for current TRDOS 386 version)
  4325                              <1> 	;		only one user/process can use only one
  4326                              <1> 	;		dma channel & one dma buffer at same time
  4327                              <1> 	;		(no multi tasking on DMA service) !!! **
  4328                              <1> 	;	     (Once, current DMA user must stop it's own DMA
  4329                              <1> 	;	      DMA service, than another user/program 
  4330                              <1> 	;	      can use DMA service with same dma channel
  4331                              <1> 	;	      or with another DMA channel.)
  4332                              <1> 	;
  4333                              <1> 	;	 For BH = 7 ; Stop DMA service (for current user
  4334                              <1> 	;	     and current DMA channel)
  4335                              <1> 	;	     EAX = 0 ; successful
  4336                              <1> 	;	     CF = 1 & EAX > 0 (= -1) -> Error
  4337                              <1> 
  4338 0001434F 80FF07              <1> 	cmp	bh, 7
  4339 00014352 7612                <1> 	jna	short sysdma_0
  4340                              <1>

  4800                              <1> 	;	BL = 2 -> write a character onto stdout (redirection)
  4801                              <1> 	;	BL = 3 -> write a character onto stderr (no redirection)
  4802                              <1> 	;	BL = 4 -> redirect stdin to file (if cl > 0)
  4803                              <1> 	;	BL = 5 -> redirect stdout to file (if cl > 0)
  4804                              <1> 	;	BL = 6 -> read character (ascii and scancode) on stdin
  4805                              <1> 	;				-no redirection, wait-
  4806                              <1> 	;	BL = 7 -> read character (ascii and scancode) on stdin
  4807                              <1> 	;				-no redirection, no wait-
  4808                              <1> 	;	BL = 8 -> write character and color onto stdout
  4809                              <1> 	;				-no redirection-
  4810                              <1> 	;	BL = 9 -> ungetchar (put back the ascii code in u.getc)
  4811                              <1> 	;
  4812                              <1> 	;	For BL=2,3,8,9
  4813                              <1> 	;	    CL = character (ascii) code
  4814                              <1> 	;	For BL=8
  4815                              <1> 	;	    CH = color (Attribute) -CGA-
  4816                              <1> 	;	For BL=4,5
  4817                              <1> 	;	    CL = file descriptor number + 1
  4818                              <1> 	;	    (File must be open and that number is 'u.fp' index)
  4819                              <1> 	;
  4820                              <1> 	;	07/09/2024 (these subfunctions will not be handled
  4821                              <1> 	;		   by kernel v2.0.9 for now)
  4822                              <1> 	;	 -I am writing them here for C compiler compatibility,
  4823                              <1> 	;	  for now. Ref: SCC STDIO.H-
  4824                              <1> 	;	BL = 10 -> get STDAUX status
  4825                              <1> 	;	BL = 11 -> get/select STDAUX (COM) port
  4826                              <1> 	;				(clears redirection)
  4827                              <1> 	;	BL = 12 -> redirect STDAUX
  4828                              <1> 	;	BL = 13 -> STDAUX IOCTL (control functions)
  4829                              <1> 	;	BL = 14 -> read byte/character from STDAUX
  4830                              <1> 	;	BL = 15 -> write byte/character to STDAUX
  4831                              <1> 	;	BL = 16 -> get STDPRN status (LPT printer only)
  4832                              <1> 	;	BL = 17 -> redirect STDPRN
  4833                              <1> 	;	BL = 18 -> STDPRN IOCTL (init/control functions)
  4834                              <1> 	;	BL = 19 -> write byte/character to STDPRN
  4835                              <1> 	;
  4836                              <1> 	;	For BL = 11
  4837                              <1> 	;	    If	CL = 0 -> get STDAUX (COM) port number
  4838                              <1> 	;		CL = 1 -> COM1
  4839                              <1> 	;		CL = 2 -> COM2
  4840                              <1> 	;		CL > 4 -> invalid
  4841                              <1> 	;	For BL = 12
  4842                              <1> 	;	    If ECX = 0 -> clear redirection
  4843                              <1> 	;	    If  CH & 7Fh = 0 -> redirect INPUT
  4844                              <1> 	;	        CH & 7Fh > 0 -> redirect OUTPUT
  4845                              <1> 	;	    If  CH & 80h = 80h 
  4846                              <1> 	;		CL = file handle (descriptor index)
  4847                              <1> 	;	    If  CH & 80h = 0
  4848                              <1> 	;		CL = console (pseudo) tty number,
  4849                              <1> 	;		     1 to 8 for tty0 to tty7.
  4850                              <1> 	;	For BL = 13
  4851                              <1> 	;	    If CL = 0 -> get control byte
  4852                              <1> 	;	    If CL > 1 -> set control byte (in CL)
  4853                              <1> 	;		bit 0 = 1
  4854                              <1> 	;		bit 1 = data bits (set=8, clear=7)
  4855                              <1> 	;		bit 2 = stop bit (set=2, clear=1)
  4856                              <1> 	;		bit 3 = parity bit (set=yes, clear=no)
  4857                              <1> 	;		bit 4 = parity bit (set=even, clear=odd)
  4858                              <1> 	;		bit 5-6-7 = data rate
  4859                              <1> 	;			000 = 9600
  4860                              <1> 	;		        001 = 19200
  4861                              <1> 	;			010 = 38400
  4862                              <1> 	;			011 = 57600
  4863                              <1> 	;			100 = 115200
  4864                              <1> 	;	For BL = 15, 19
  4865                              <1> 	;	    CL = byte/character to r/w
  4866                              <1> 	;	For BL = 17
  4867                              <1> 	;	    If ECX = 0 -> clear redirection
  4868                              <1> 	;	    If  CH & 80h = 80h 
  4869                              <1> 	;		CL = file handle (descriptor index)
  4870                              <1> 	;	    If  CH & 80h = 0
  4871                              <1> 	;		CL = console (pseudo) tty number,
  4872                              <1> 	;		     1 to 8 for tty0 to tty7.
  4873                              <1> 	;	For BL = 18
  4874                              <1> 	;	    If CL = 0 -> initialize printer (command=0)
  4875                              <1> 	;	       CL > 0 -> configuration/command byte
  4876                              <1> 	;			 (reserved, not used)
  4877                              <1> 	;
  4878                              <1> 	; Outputs:
  4879                              <1> 	;
  4880                              <1> 	;	For BL=0,1,2,3,6,7,8,9
  4881                              <1> 	;	    AL = character (ascii) code
  4882                              <1> 	;	For BL=6,7
  4883                              <1> 	;	    AH = scan code
  4884                              <1> 	;	For BL=4,5
  4885                              <1> 	;	    AL = file descriptor (CL input - 1)
  4886                              <1> 	;
  4887                              <1> 	;	If CF=1
  4888                              <1> 	;	   AL (EAX) = error code

  4890                              <1> 	;
  4891                              <1> 	;	07/09/2024

  4894                              <1> 	;    .. If CF = 0 ...
  4895                              <1> 	;	For BL = 10 & 16
  4896                              <1> 	;	    AL (EAX) = status
  4897                              <1> 	;	For BL = 11
  4898                              <1> 	;	    EAX/AL = COM (serial) port (1 to 4)

    93                              <1> 
    94                              <1> ; 20/05/2025 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.10
    95                              <1> ; Ref: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/8.3_filename#Directory_table
    96                              <1> ; 
    97                              <1> ; DOS filenames include the following:
    98                              <1> ;  UpperCase letters A-Z
    99                              <1> ;  Numbers 0-9
   100                              <1> ;  Space (20h)
   101                              <1> ;  !, #, $, %, &, ', (, ), -, @, ^, _, `, {, }, ~
   102                              <1> ;  Values 128 255
   103                              <1> ;
   104                              <1> ; This excludes the following ASCII characters:
   105                              <1> ;  ", *, +, ,, /, :, ;, <, =, >, ?, \, [, ], |
   106                              <1> ;  . (DOT) within name and extension fields,
   107                              <1> ;			 except in . and .. entries

   134                              <1> ; Invalid Long File Name Chars - Windows
   135                              <1> ;
   136                              <1> ; ref: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/1976007/
   137                              <1> ; what-characters-are-forbidden-in-windows-and-linux-directory-names
   138                              <1> ;
   139                              <1> ; 1. The forbidden printable ASCII characters are:
   140                              <1> ;
   141                              <1> ; < (less than)
   142                              <1> ; > (greater than)
   143                              <1> ; : (colon - sometimes works, but is actually NTFS Alternate Data Streams)
   144                              <1> ; " (double quote)
   145                              <1> ; / (forward slash)
   146                              <1> ; \ (backslash)
   147                              <1> ; | (vertical bar or pipe)
   148                              <1> ; ? (question mark)
   149                              <1> ; * (asterisk)
   150                              <1> ;
   151                              <1> ; 2. Non-printable characters:
   152                              <1> ;
   153                              <1> ; 0-31 (ASCII control characters)
   154                              <1> ; 
   155                              <1> ; 3. Reserved file names:
   156                              <1> ;
   157                              <1> ; CON, PRN, AUX, NUL 
   158                              <1> ; COM1, COM2, COM3, COM4, COM5, COM6, COM7, COM8, COM9
   159                              <1> ; LPT1, LPT2, LPT3, LPT4, LPT5, LPT6, LPT7, LPT8, LPT9
   160                              <1> ; 
   161                              <1> ; (both on their own and with arbitrary file extensions, e.g. LPT1.txt).
   162                              <1> 
   163                              <1> ; 27/05/2025
